我明白了。
也许渡轮可以再次起航了...
感谢你们为我们所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I'd better get ready to set sail then.
It's not much, but this is for you.
If we can get back in business, I'll take you to Izlude for just 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
那我得准备起航了。
虽然不多，但这是给你的。
如果我们恢复运营，我只收你1000 Zeny就能带你去依斯鲁得岛。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
If you want to go to Alberta, use the big ship over there.
This little one goes to Izlude.
That will be 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
如果你想去艾尔贝塔，请使用那边的大船。
这艘小船只去依斯鲁得岛。
费用是1000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: That's a rip off!
scripts.translation: 太贵了！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
What?!
How much do you pay for the Alberta Liner to get here!?
Call this a rip off... You think I'm doing charity?
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
什么？！
你去艾尔贝塔的渡轮要付多少钱？！
说这太贵...你以为我在做慈善吗？

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
The price is 1000 zeny.
I can't help you there~
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
价格是1000 Zeny。
我帮不了你~

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Thank you~
Let's go before the ghosts come back!
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
谢谢~
在幽灵回来之前，我们快走吧！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
You know what to do.
Gather the flowers and take it to Mumbaki to get an Offering Bouquet made.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
你知道该怎么做。
去采集花朵，然后交给蒙巴基制作供奉用花束。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Give the Bouquet to Miss Diwata to cheer her up.
....Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
把花束交给迪瓦塔小姐，让她开心起来。
...谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Diwata is calm!
I can even feel the difference out here.
I am always in your debt.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
迪瓦塔平静下来了！
我甚至能感觉到这里的氛围变了。
我欠你一个人情。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
You know what? Why don't you do this on a more regular basis?
I think you kind of like doing it.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
你知道吗？你不妨经常这么做。
我觉得你挺喜欢做这件事的。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Ah, the thing is...
We can't go right now..
You see, the ghosts are back...
I'm fed up with nuisance.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
啊，问题是...
我们现在不能过去...
你看，幽灵又回来了...
我受够了这种麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I mean... Miss Diwata... Isn't feeling very well and, even with the Spiritual Protection
a normal person can't stand it.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
我是说...迪瓦塔小姐...身体很不舒服，即使有护身符，普通人也无法忍受。

scripts.text: I see. Take care then.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。那你保重。

scripts.text: How about a Floral Tribute?
scripts.translation: 献上花束如何？

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I'm glad you understand.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
很高兴你能理解。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Hmmm. That would be nice.
If she can be soothed with flowers...!
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德罗]
嗯。那也不错。
如果花能安抚她...！
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
- A creepy Little Girl is standing.
As our eyes meet, a chill runs down my spine with goose bumps all over. -
scripts.translation:
- 一个诡异的小女孩站在那里。
当我们的目光相遇时，一股寒意顺着我的脊背爬上来，全身起鸡皮疙瘩。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Are you here to bully Diwata too?
I won't have it!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你是来欺负迪瓦塔的吗？
我不允许！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out after the Little Girl's low creepy voice and flash from her eyes.-
scripts.translation: - 我被小女孩低沉诡异的声音和眼中的闪光震飞了出去。 -

scripts.text:
- A creepy Little Girl is standing.
As our eyes meet, a chill runs down my spine with goose bumps all over. -
scripts.translation:
- 一个诡异的小女孩站在那里。
当我们的目光相遇时，一股寒意顺着我的脊背爬上来，全身起鸡皮疙瘩。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Are you here to bully Diwata too?
I won't have it!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你是来欺负迪瓦塔的吗？
我不允许！

scripts.text: Wait! I just want to talk!
scripts.translation: 等等！我只是想谈谈！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Then who are they behind you?
You're one of them!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
那你身后的是谁？
你是他们一伙的！

scripts.text: - Familiar souls are approaching Diwata. -
scripts.translation: - 使魔的灵魂正逼近迪瓦塔。 -

scripts.text: It's a misunderstanding!
scripts.translation: 这是个误会！

scripts.text: You're from that..!
scripts.translation: 你是从那里来的..！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just as I thought! You're afraid of me?!
Stand aside!
I need to talk to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
果然如此！你怕我？！
让开！
我需要和她谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
I don't know why they're backing away...
You get out of my sight too!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
我不知道他们为什么在后退...
你也从我眼前消失！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out after the Little Girl's annoyed cry and flash from her eyes.-
scripts.translation: - 在小女孩愤怒的喊叫和眼中闪烁的光芒中，我被扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Enough!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
够了！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out after the Little Girl's resolute cry and flash from her eyes.-
scripts.translation: - 在小女孩坚定的喊叫和眼中闪烁的光芒中，我被扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
You crawled back in?
Get out-!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你又爬回来了？
给我滚出去——！！！！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out after the Little Girl's screeching cry and flash from her eyes.-
scripts.translation: - 在小女孩尖锐的喊叫和眼中闪烁的光芒中，我被扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
- The soul of Little Girl Diwata is looking at me fiercely.
No Offering Bouquet...!!!
scripts.translation:
- 小女孩迪瓦塔的灵魂正凶狠地盯着我。
没有供奉用花束...！！！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out with a remote look from her.-
scripts.translation: - 在她冷漠的目光中，我被扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
- The soul of Little Girl Diwata is looking at me fiercely. -
- The Offering Bouquet... -
scripts.translation:
- 小女孩迪瓦塔的灵魂正凶狠地盯着我。 -
- 供奉用花束... -

scripts.text: Throw it to the Little Girl.
scripts.translation: 把花束扔给小女孩。

scripts.text: Slide it across on the floor.
scripts.translation: 把花束在地上滑过去。

scripts.text:
- I threw the bouquet before she could toss me out, and she catches in surprise...
She won't toss me... far, now that she has the flower.-
scripts.translation:
- 在她把我扔出去之前，我扔出了花束，她惊讶地接住了...
既然她有了花，就不会把我扔得太远了。

scripts.text: - I slid the flower across the floor to her. She looks puzzled. -
scripts.translation: - 我把花在地上滑到她面前。她看起来很困惑。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What is the meaning of this?
You're not an enemy?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
这是什么意思？
你不是敌人？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What? You're an outsider too?
Ha, so live ones are allowed and I'm not?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
什么？你也是外人？
哈，所以活人是可以进来的，而我却不行？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Now there's the stereotype of countryside people over outsiders.
I am so annoyed. I feel like wiping them off the map.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
真是乡下人对外人的刻板印象。
我真的很烦。真想让他们从地图上消失。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What? I shouldn't?
Why should I not?
I'm stalling the ship?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
什么？我不应该这样？
为什么我不应该？
是我在阻碍船只吗？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
I was going to hear you out because of the flowers
but you're telling me lies?!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
我本来想因为花而听你解释
结果你却在骗我？！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
So you're saying that I brought these hillbillies on this ship
and that fighting with them is causing the stall?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
所以你是说，是我把这些乡下人带上船的
而且和他们打架导致了船只停滞？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
... Hmm... Humph. It wasn't what I was intending to do.
But they're the ones who're getting on my nerves!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
... 嗯... 哼。这不是我的本意。
但是是他们让我心烦意乱！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
... I can't get off anyway.
Which means that I could feel bad again. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
... 反正我也下不了船。
这意味着我可能会再次感到难过。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
... I'll try to keep it in today.
It's not because I like the flowers or because I like having company!
It's because I was treated the same way as those cheap ghosts!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
... 我今天会尽量忍耐的。
不是因为我喜欢花，也不是因为我喜欢有人陪伴！
是因为我被像那些低贱的幽灵一样对待了！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Now if you'll excuse me.
And I'll be clear. I'm not going to hold my temper for so long.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
好了，请回吧。
我要说清楚。我不会一直压抑我的脾气。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Now, g... go away!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
现在，走... 快走开！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
I promise I'll be a good little girl if those hillbillies leave me alone.
If they bother me again, however, I won't be.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
我保证，如果那些乡下人不再打扰我，我会做个乖女孩。
但如果他们再来惹我，我就不保证了。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Surprisingly enough, I'm doing fine.
Of course I'm tense for when they return,
but, as always, I'll win.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
出乎意料的是，我过得还不错。
当然，一想到他们可能会回来，我就很紧张，
但一如既往，我会赢的。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Then the poor crew will cry again
I just can't calm myself down after a fight.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
那样可怜的水手们又要哭了。
每次打架之后，我都无法让自己平静下来。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
The flowers you bring makes me calm down.
....
.. It's not because I miss people or I like the flowers. Don't take it the wrong way.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你带来的花让我平静下来。
....
.. 不是因为我想念人类，也不是因为我喜欢花。别误会。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Get lost!
What? Oh, it's you.
Those hillbillies came back again!
I'm going to kill them!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
滚开！
什么？哦，是你啊。
那些乡下人又回来了！
我要杀了他们！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
It's good to look at flowers from abroad~
Do all flowers from the warm parts of the world smell so nice?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
看看来自异国的花真不错~
所有来自温暖地区的花都这么香吗？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
The flowers you bring makes me calm down.
....
.. It's not because I miss people or I like the flowers. Don't take it the wrong way.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你带来的花让我平静下来。
....
.. 不是因为我想念人类，也不是因为我喜欢花。别误会。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Darn it! Have you come for more?!
What?
Oh. It's you?
I'm really depressed right now.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
该死！你是来要更多的吗？！
什么？
哦。是你啊？
我现在真的很沮丧。

scripts.text: - Diwata reached her hands out as if expecting something. -
scripts.translation: - 迪瓦塔伸出手，仿佛在期待什么。 -

scripts.text: Give the Bouquet.
scripts.translation: 递上花束

scripts.text: Hold her hand.
scripts.translation: 握住她的手

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What do you think you're doing?!!??!?!!
Arghhhh - I have enough creeps around here, thank you!!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你想干什么？！！？？！？！
啊——这里已经够多讨厌鬼了，谢谢！！

scripts.text: -I was tossed out with Diwata's thunderous cry.-
scripts.translation: - 我被迪瓦塔的一声怒吼扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What? You want me to wave?
You didn't bring it?
You didn't?!?
Arghhh you just can't trust anybody! Anybody!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
什么？你想让我挥手？
你没带花来？
你没带？！？
啊——真是什么人都不能信！谁都不能信！

scripts.text: -I was tossed out with Diwata's thunderous cry.-
scripts.translation: - 我被迪瓦塔的一声怒吼扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
... Oh... Just as I thought!
My only happiness, my only peace of mind..!
Flowers from abroad~!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
... 哦... 果然如此！
我唯一的幸福，我唯一的安宁..！
来自异国的花~！

scripts.text: -Diwata seems to feel better. The atmosphere shifts to a more refreshing ambience.-
scripts.translation: - 迪瓦塔似乎感觉好多了。气氛变得清新起来。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Tell Pedro the Sailor!
Diwata will be a goddess of sea, so set sail in my generosity.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
告诉水手佩德罗！
迪瓦塔将成为海上的女神，所以请带着我的慷慨扬帆起航吧。

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 无法继续任务。您携带的物品过多。-

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Welcome to Baryo, stranger.
I am the soul guidance, protector of people and souls here at Baryo.
So, I'm a good leader Kiko in Mumbaki.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
欢迎来到巴里奥，陌生人。
我是这里的灵魂向导，守护着巴里奥的人们和灵魂。
所以，我是个好领导，蒙巴基的奇科。

scripts.text: Give Cast-Iron Caldron.
scripts.translation: 交出生铁做的锅

scripts.text: Request Purification Ritual.
scripts.translation: 请求净化仪式

scripts.text: Exchange Jellopy for gold.
scripts.translation: 用杰勒比结晶换金币

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
What cauldron?
As far as I know, you're not the one bringing it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
什么锅？
据我所知，你并不是那个送锅的人。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Poor thing.
do not live a life of lies.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
可怜的家伙。
不要活在谎言中。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Baryo is not a great place for smithy work.
So we always ask a favor to the forge of Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
巴里奥并不是适合铁匠工作的地方。
所以我们总是请求马拉亚的铁匠帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Bakonawa does not like loud noises.
That's why we beat the sturdy Cast Iron Cauldrons.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
巴库暴龙不喜欢吵闹的声音。
所以我们总是敲打结实的生铁做的锅。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
The Spiritual Protection is proof that I've got my cauldron,
so deliver it well. Okay? Good.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
护身符是我拿到锅的证明，
所以请好好保管它。好吗？很好。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Oh, must be the cauldron I ordered.
But, where is it?
Are you mocking me?!
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
哦，那应该是我订的锅。
但是，它在哪里？
你在嘲笑我吗？！

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Yes, excellent!
Very Good.
We can aggravate the Bakonawa more with this.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
是的，太棒了！
非常好。
我们可以用这个让巴库暴龙更生气。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
I'll give you this for the cauldron.
I hear you're having some trouble with souls?
Take this. It will help you.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
我把这个给你作为锅的报酬。
听说你在灵魂方面有些麻烦？
拿着这个。它会帮到你的。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
The only purification needed in this village is Vantai's food.
There are no rituals where an outsider, like yourself, can take part in.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
这个村庄唯一需要净化的是万泰的食物。
没有外人像你这样能参加的仪式。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Vantai must be hungry.
Go give it to him.
Quickly now.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
万泰一定饿了。
快去给他吃。
快点。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Purification of the bones the Guard Dog Vantai needs to gnaw on?
My work here just gets better and better.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
净化卫兵万泰需要啃的骨头？
我的工作越来越好了。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Go into the forest and fetch me ^4d4dff10 Evil Spirit Bones^000000 and ^4d4dff10 Holy Waters^000000 for the purification ritual.
I'll do the ritual myself.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
去森林里给我拿^4d4dff10恶灵之骨^000000和^4d4dff10圣水^000000来净化仪式。
我会亲自进行仪式。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Bones from the animals of this forest all have bad spirits within.
Of course it cannot be helped due to the malignant spirits flailing about...
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
这片森林里的动物骨头都带有邪恶的灵魂。
当然，由于邪恶灵魂的肆虐，这是不可避免的...

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
You do this and do this here and there and...
There. The evil spirit has left and the bone is so pure that you can just chew on it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
你在这里做这个，在那里做那个...
好了。邪恶的灵魂已经离开了，骨头变得如此纯净，你可以直接啃了。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Now, take this back to Dong the Guard.
Vantai will become stronger after eating this purified Evil Spirit Bone.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
现在，把这个拿回给卫兵东。
万泰吃了这块净化的恶灵之骨后会变得更强。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Moreover, holding on to Evil Spirit Bones will only do you harm,
so I'll take them all to purify.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
而且，持有恶灵之骨只会对你有害，
所以我会把它们全部拿去净化。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Oh no you don't!
Don't you dare!
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
不，你不行！
你不敢！

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 无法继续任务。您携带的物品过多。-

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Hi there!
Welcome to Baryo.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
你好！
欢迎来到巴里奥。

scripts.text: You're job seems so hard~
scripts.translation: 你的工作看起来好辛苦~

scripts.text: Guard Dog Vantai
scripts.translation: 看门狗 万泰

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Not at all. I just watch who comes and goes from here.
Travelers are the ones who go through more hardship.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
一点也不辛苦。我只是在这里看着谁进谁出。
反而是旅行者要经历更多的艰辛。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Vantai is a nice dog.
He's probably stronger than you.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
万泰是一只很棒的狗。
它可能比你还要强。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
No offense, but
you look weaker than the original owners of the bones Vantai chews on.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
别介意，
但你看起来比万泰啃的那些骨头的原主人还要弱。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
That means just about as strong as me!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
也就是说，你大概和我一样强！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
The bones you brought Vantai gave him a feast.
He'll be full and merry for a while now.
Nobody can beat Vantai in recon around here.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
你带给万泰的骨头让它大饱口福。
它现在心满意足，精神得很。
在这一带，没人能在侦察方面胜过万泰。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Though it is not nice to say a person is lesser than a dog,
but there are some who are lesser.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
虽然把人和狗比较不太礼貌，
但确实有些人不如狗。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Vantai?
Always the same.
Now that you mention it, it's almost time for him to get hungry.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
万泰？
老样子。
说起来，它差不多该饿了。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Of course, he eats normal dog food, but he can't go without those.
You know what I mean, right?
Smirk...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
当然，它也吃普通的狗粮，但它离不开那些东西。
你懂我意思吧？
嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Me and Vantai are always waiting
for the hero to get us some Evil Spirit Bones from the forest.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
我和万泰一直在等英雄从普勒斯特森林给我们带些恶灵之骨回来。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
What I'm saying is that, to be a good guard dog, he must be able to stand ground against evil spirits.
For that he needs to eat Evil Spirit Bones, but it must be purified before he can eat them.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
我的意思是，要成为一只好的看门狗，它必须能抵御邪恶灵魂。
为此它需要吃恶灵之骨，但在吃之前必须先净化。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
You can get Evil Spirit Bones from monsters or animals in the forest.
Kiko in Mumbaki will purify them for you.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
你可以从普勒斯特森林的魔物或动物身上获得恶灵之骨。
蒙巴基的 奇科会帮你净化它们。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Kiko in Mumbaki asked for 10 Purified Spirit Bones.
He needs to have at least 10 at a time. Which of course does not last a day...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
蒙巴基的 奇科需要10块净化灵魂之骨。
他每次至少需要10块。当然，这根本不够吃一天的...

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Hey, Vantai will love these!
It's all in good condition...
An evil bone purified through holy ritual...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
嘿，万泰会喜欢这些的！
它们状态都很好...
经过神圣仪式净化的恶灵之骨...

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
This is the perfect dog food!!
Now he can sense and detect evil spirits,
and since he ate purified ones, he'll get the ability to eradicate them.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
这是完美的狗粮！！
现在它能感知和猎鹰寻敌邪恶灵魂，
而且因为吃了净化的骨头，它还能获得消灭它们的能力。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
I bet he's the strongest living thing in the village now.
Of course not me. I mean Vantai.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
我敢打赌，它现在是村庄里最强的生物。
当然不包括我。我是说万泰。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
This is your reward.
It would be very nice if you could help us again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
这是你的奖励。
如果你明天能再帮我们要一次，那就太棒了。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Vantai is not only a guard dog, but he's also a great detector and recon scout.
But for him to do so, he needs to eat Purified Spirit Bones.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
万泰不仅是一只看门狗，它还是出色的探测者和侦察兵。
但要做到这些，它需要吃净化灵魂之骨。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
As you can see, I can't move from here,
so I was wondering if you can get the bones for Vantai...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
你也看到了，我走不开，
所以想问问你能不能帮万泰弄些骨头...

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: Sorry.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
I see.
Vantai!
No treat for you today..!!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
我明白了。
万泰！
今天没有你的零食了..!!

scripts.text: - It seems like Vantai's eyes are more moist today. -
scripts.translation: - 看起来万泰今天的眼神更加湿润了。 -

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Bones can be acquired from animals or monsters around here.
Take them to Kiko in Mumbaki for purification, which, in turn, can be given to Vantai to eat.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
骨头可以从附近的动物或魔物身上获取。
把它们交给蒙巴基的奇科进行净化，之后就可以给万泰吃了。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Bring us 10 Purified Spirit Bones.
That reminds me. You'll need Holy Water for the purification ritual.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
请给我们带来10个净化灵魂之骨。
对了。净化仪式需要用到圣水。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Take your time.
Look here. Vantai likes it too.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 东]
请慢慢来。
看这里。万泰也很喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Vantai]
Grrrrrrr...
 
(He is intimidated by you.)
scripts.translation:
[万泰]
Grrrrrrr...
 
(它对你感到畏惧。)

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 无法继续任务。您携带的物品过多。-

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Umm... Hey...
Oh, no, sorry. You don't look so strong or bold.
I'm sorry. I'm just not quite myself...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
嗯... 嘿...
啊，不，抱歉。你看起来并不强壮或勇敢。
对不起。我有点不太对劲...

scripts.text: An anxious looking woman is stands.
scripts.translation: 一位神情焦虑的女子站在那里。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Now that the children know that they can get back home with an Inside-out Shirt,
they play out in the forest recklessly and timelessly.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
既然孩子们知道只要穿着反穿的衬衫就能回家，
他们就在森林里肆无忌惮、没日没夜地玩耍。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
The children will surely get lost again in these conditions.
If it happens again, I'll seek your help again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
在这种状况下，孩子们肯定会再次迷路。
如果再次发生，我会再次寻求你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
I'm missing a child... again.
Oh my goodness...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
我又少了一个孩子...
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Maries]
You came back.
Thanks to you, the child has returned home safely.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
你回来了。
多亏了你，孩子已经安全回家了。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Although the shirt is inside-out, it miraculously brings them back to where they should be.
Thank you for delivering those precious shirts to my children.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
虽然衬衫是反穿的，但它奇迹般地能让他们回到该在的地方。
谢谢你把那些珍贵的衬衫送到我的孩子们手中。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
I'm sure they're lost in the woods because of mischievous spirits.
Please give the child the ^4d4dffInside-out Shirt^000000 when found.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
我确信他们是因为调皮的精灵而在树林里迷路了。
找到孩子时，请给他们^4d4dff反穿的衬衫^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
The Inside-out Shirts...
You can probably get them from the demons, since they ran away with them.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
反穿的衬衫...
既然恶魔把它们抢走了，你应该能从恶魔那里拿到。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Hello... I'm looking for my child...
My daughter did not return.
Please help, I think she's lost in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
你好... 我在找我的孩子...
我的女儿没有回来。
请帮帮我，我想她在森林里迷路了。

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 当然可以。

scripts.text: I'm too busy right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在太忙了。

scripts.text: You have so many children.
scripts.translation: 你有这么多孩子。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
I'm sure she's lost in the woods because of mischievous spirits.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
我确信她是因为调皮的精灵而在树林里迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
If she's cursed, it will be difficult to get her out of there.
She'll drift around in the maze so mesmerizing, even for you, in fact.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
如果她被诅咒了，想把她带出来就会很困难。
她会在迷宫中迷失方向，那种迷惑力非常强大，甚至对你也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Acquire an ^4d4dffInside-out Shirt^000000 and give it to my daughter.
Although the shirt is inside-out, it miraculously brings them back to where they should be.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
请获取一件^4d4dff反穿的衬衫^000000，并把它交给我的女儿。
虽然这件衬衫是反穿的，但它有奇迹般的效果，能让他们回到该去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
The Inside-out Shirts...
You can probably get them from the demons, since they ran away with them.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
反穿的衬衫...
既然恶魔把它们抢走了，你应该能从恶魔那里拿到。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
... Yes... I see.
I'll have to ask someone else.
Alright.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
...是的...我明白了。
看来我得找别人帮忙了。
好吧。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Maries]
...I ended up having triplets.
Even I sometimes get confused. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
...我竟然生了三胞胎。
连我自己有时候都会搞混。*轻笑*

scripts.text:
[Maries]
They seem to be under a curse because one of them always get's lost in the woods..
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽埃斯]
她们似乎中了诅咒，因为其中一个总是在树林里迷路。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
He he, the forest is scary, but it's so much fun so I go there often to play~
Strange, how we always get lost.
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
呵呵，森林虽然有点可怕，但非常有趣，所以我经常去那里玩~
奇怪，为什么我们总是迷路呢。

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
But it's okay because I'm not the only one getting lost~
We're triplets~ And we're missing the other two~ Giggle~
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
不过没关系，因为迷路的不止我一个~
我们是三胞胎~另外两个也不见了~嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Sigh. Are you lost too?
They are so naughty.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
唉。你也迷路了吗？
她们真调皮。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
An Inside-out Shirt is just what I need.
*Chuckle*...
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
一件反穿的衬衫正是我需要的。
*轻笑*...

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Oh, darn them.
They must have tricked me into getting lost again!
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
哎呀，真是的。
她们肯定又骗我，让我再次迷路了！

scripts.text: Do you want to go home?
scripts.translation: 你想回家吗？

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
If I don't get back soon, my mom will be worried sick.
Sigh... I wish I had an Inside-out Shirt to go back.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
如果我不快点回去，妈妈会担心坏的。
唉...要是有一件反穿的衬衫能带我回去就好了。

scripts.text: Here you are.
scripts.translation: 给你。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Really?
It really is the shirt!
This will take me straight home!
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
真的吗？
这真的是那件衬衫！
它能直接带我回家！

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Did mom send you?
She must be worried..!
I'll go home now!
Thanks' a lot!
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
是妈妈派你来的吗？
她一定很担心...！
我现在就回家！
太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
I want to play some more.
I can always go back with this shirt.
Mom won't be concerned.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
我还想再玩一会儿。
反正有这件衬衫随时都能回去。
妈妈不会担心的。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Hmmm. Am I lost again?
Where am I...
I'm sure I have to head in the direction of sunrise from the third tree to get home... Huh?
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
嗯...我又迷路了吗？
我在哪里...
我记得要从第三棵树往日出方向走才能回家...咦？

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Why~ Do I always go in circles here?
Do you why, {0}?
What's with this road?
Is somebody trying to trick me?
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
为什么~我在这里总是绕圈圈？
你知道吗，{0}？
这条路怎么回事？
是不是有人在捉弄我？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Hey hey hey~
I am such a nice Capre~ Hey!
I am going to a fine cafe~YO!
I am better than yesterday~Hey!
I'm a fine rhyming Capre~Oh?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
嘿~嘿~嘿~
我是多么善良的卡普雷~嘿！
我要去一家很棒的咖啡馆~哟！
我比昨天更棒了~嘿！
我是个会押韵的卡普雷~哦？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Hey buddy, You here to hear Budidai singing?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
嘿，伙计，你是来听布迪代唱歌的吗？

scripts.text: You like songs?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢唱歌吗？

scripts.text: A profound study of one eyed monsters.
scripts.translation: 关于独眼魔物的深入研究

scripts.text: See ya!
scripts.translation: 再见！

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Yup, Budidai loves singing.
Cows, horses, goats, roosters, boars all love my songs.
They're all friends.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
没错，布迪代喜欢唱歌。
奶牛、马、山羊、公鸡、野猪都喜欢我的歌。
它们都是我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Except for that one eyed Bongisungisu.
He picks on my friends.
I am annoyed, but Budidai is weak.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
除了那个独眼的邦吉松吉苏。
它欺负我的朋友。
我很生气，但布迪代很弱。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
I fear it's single gaze, but I fear more the club he flails.
I have to sing my friends some songs, but they don't come because of him.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
我害怕它那只独眼，但更害怕它挥舞的棍棒。
我想给朋友们唱歌，但因为它的缘故，它们都不敢来了。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
So Budidai, sings here.
Lots of travelers pass by.
Capre is a wanderer's buddy.
You're a buddy too.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
所以布迪代在这里唱歌。
很多旅行者经过这里。
卡普雷是浪姬舞者的伙伴。
你也是我的伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You interested in that fiend, my friend?
It's just a bully of the forest!
It picks on my animal friends!
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你对那个恶霸感兴趣吗，朋友？
它只是普勒斯特森林里的恶霸！
它欺负我的动物朋友们！

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Sadly, singing is all that Budidai is skilled at.
I can't do anything about the scary gaze and the flailing club.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
可惜，布迪代只会唱歌。
我没办法对付那可怕的目光和挥舞的棍棒。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Bongisungisu! I get the chills just by being in the same forest with it...
But Budidai is weak.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
邦吉松吉苏！光是和它在同一片森林里，我就感到毛骨悚然...
但布迪代很弱。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You and me, wanderer.
We'll never make it.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你和我，浪姬舞者。
我们永远也打不过它。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Traveler, my friend!
Bongisungisu ran far far away.
Dogs, cows, horse, goat and rooster will come back to me, won't they?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
旅行者，我的朋友！
邦吉松吉苏跑得很远很远了。
狗、奶牛、马、山羊和公鸡会回到我身边，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
But Budidai is worried.
The one eyed bully will return eventually.
Will you help me out again?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
但布迪代很担心。
那个独眼恶霸迟早会回来的。
你会再帮帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You, friend of Budidai
You won't turn you're back on a good Capre?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你，布迪代的朋友。
你不会背弃善良的卡普雷吧？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Astonishing, wanderer!
I could hear the pitiful wails of Bongisungisu all the way from here!
Budidai can sing again for his friends, yes?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
太了不起了，浪姬舞者！
我甚至能听到邦吉松吉苏凄惨的哀嚎声！
布迪代可以再次为朋友们唱歌了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Now, what can Budidai do for the kind wanderer, slayer of the one eyed monster?
Aha! Here's a talisman.
It will be good for you travelers.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
那么，善良的浪姬舞者，独眼魔物的杀手，布迪代能为你做些什么呢？
啊！这里有一个护身符。
对你们旅行者会有用的。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Kind Capre is a friend of travelers.
I hope to see you again, wanderer.
This is a blessing for friends. Hey hey hey~
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
善良的卡普雷是旅行者的朋友。
希望再次见到你，浪姬舞者。
这是给朋友的祝福。嘿~嘿~嘿~

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Please slay the destructive libertine Bongisungisu.
For me, a Capre to sing again for one's friends.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
请击败那个破坏狂邦吉松吉苏。
为了我，一个能再次为朋友唱歌的卡普雷。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Hey, kind wanderer.
Bongisungisu, the one eyed debauchee is back!
What do I do? What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
嘿，善良的浪姬舞者。
独眼恶霸邦吉松吉苏又回来了！
我该怎么办？我该怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
He gets angry when I sing.
But the horse, cow, goat, dog and boars love it.
It gives Budidai such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
我唱歌时它会生气。
但马、奶牛、山羊、狗和野猪都喜欢听。
它让布迪代很为难。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You interested in that fiend, my friend?
It's just a bully of the forest!
It picks on my animal friends!
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你对那个恶霸感兴趣吗，朋友？
它只是普勒斯特森林里的恶霸！
它欺负我的动物朋友们！

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Sadly, singing is all that Budidai is skilled at.
I can't do anything about the scary gaze and the flailing club.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
可惜，布迪代只会唱歌。
我没办法对付那可怕的目光和挥舞的棍棒。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Bongisungisu! I get the chills just by being in the same forest with it...
But Budidai is weak.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
邦吉松吉苏！光是和它在同一片森林里，我就感到毛骨悚然...
但布迪代很弱。

scripts.text: Shall I take care of it?
scripts.translation: 我去解决它？

scripts.text: That does give the chills.
scripts.translation: 那确实让人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Don't remind me.
My friends can't come and listen to my songs because of that behemoth.
It is so frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
别提醒我了。
因为那个庞然大物，我的朋友们没法来听我唱歌。
真是让人沮丧。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You'd teach Bongisungisu a lesson?!
Kind wanderer!!
Kick some libertine butt!!
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你要给邦吉松吉苏一个教训？！
善良的浪姬舞者！！
去揍那个无赖的屁股！！

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Leave me wanderer~
Capre Budidai will sing of wonders~
You best everyone else~
You bring all them beasts~
Just go back to Kafra~
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
去吧，浪姬舞者~
卡普拉布迪代将歌颂奇迹~
你胜过所有人~
你驯服了所有野兽~
快回卡普拉吧~

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Hey hey hey~
Blessing of the Kind and Good Capre~
A wanderer's friend the gift of Capre~
Hey hey hey~
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
嘿 嘿 嘿~
善良卡普拉的祝福~
送给浪姬舞者的礼物~
嘿 嘿 嘿~

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because you have too many items in your possession.
scripts.translation: 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Oh! Demons are gaining more and more power in this world.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
哦！恶魔在这个世界上的力量越来越强大了。

scripts.text: We need to gather items to fight them off.
scripts.translation: 我们需要收集物品来对抗它们。

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
You don't seem to be strong enough to fight off demons.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
你似乎还不够强，无法对抗恶魔。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Will you create a Greater Agimat of Ancient Spirit with 3 Lesser Agimats and 1,000 Zeny?
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
你要用3个小型护身符和1,000 Zeny制作一个古代圣灵的护身符吗？

scripts.text: Create.
scripts.translation: 制作

scripts.text: No, thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Short on materials.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
材料不足。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Hope you win the fight with the demon.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
希望你在与恶魔的战斗中获胜。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Can't make it now but there is an old way of making it handed down by generations.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
现在无法制作，但有一种代代相传的古老制作方法。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
You need to call upon the power of Ancient Spirits. But you'll need several important materials first.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
你需要召唤古代圣灵的力量。但首先你需要几种重要的材料。

scripts.text: What are they?
scripts.translation: 是什么材料？

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
3 Lesser Agimats to hold the power of Ancient Spirits here and another special material handed down for generations.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
3个小型护身符来容纳古代圣灵的力量，以及另一种代代相传的特殊材料。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
But nobody can get this special item anymore.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
但现在没人能弄到这种特殊物品了。

scripts.text: Something money cannot buy?
scripts.translation: 是金钱买不到的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
No, no... It's this round little thing, you see?
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
不，不... 你看，就是这种圆圆的小东西。

scripts.text: Are you talking about Zeny?
scripts.translation: 你说的是Zeny吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Looks similar to the special items handed down from generations.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
看起来很像那种代代相传的特殊物品。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
As long as we have enough of that, we could make the Greater Agimat of Ancient Spirit to fight against the demons.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
只要我们有足够的材料，就能制作古代圣灵的护身符来对抗恶魔。

scripts.text: Sounds good.
scripts.translation: 听起来不错。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
In case you are too weary to take on the demons...
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
如果你太累了，不想亲自去对付恶魔的话...

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Come by with 3 Lesser Agimats and 1,000 of those so-called Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
请带着3个小型护身符和1000个所谓的Zeny过来。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
I will make a Greater Agimat of Ancient Spirit that will increase your attacks against demons by 10% for 20 min.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
我会制作一个古代圣灵的护身符，它能让你在20分钟内对恶魔的攻击力提升10%。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Hope you win the fight with the demon.
scripts.translation:
[为难的老人]
希望你在与恶魔的战斗中获胜。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because you have too many items in your possession.
scripts.translation: 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
I spent 90% of my life studying Tikbalang.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
我花了90%的人生在研究邪魔马上。

scripts.text: But you look young?
scripts.translation: 但你看起来很年轻？

scripts.text: What is Tikbalang?
scripts.translation: 什么是邪魔马？

scripts.text: Teach me how to catch a Tikbalang.
scripts.translation: 教我如何捕捉邪魔马。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
What! I might be imagining things.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
什么！我可能是在做梦。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
I look younger than I am because of my baby face. Ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
我看起来比实际年龄年轻是因为我有娃娃脸。哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Trust!! They say faith will bring you luck.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
信任！据说信任会带来好运。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha... You ask the right question.
I'm a specialist in that field. Ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
哈哈...你问对了问题。
我是这个领域的专家。尽管问吧。

scripts.text: Why won't you answer me?
scripts.translation: 你为什么不回答我？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Have you... ever been fooled by anyone around you? Why can't you believe someone's word for it? Really, ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
你...曾经被周围的人欺骗过吗？为什么你不能相信别人的话呢？真的，尽管问吧。

scripts.text: I don't have any questions.
scripts.translation: 我没有问题。

scripts.text: Characteristics?
scripts.translation: 特征？

scripts.text: Features?
scripts.translation: 特点？

scripts.text: Rumors?
scripts.translation: 传闻？

scripts.text: Habitat?
scripts.translation: 栖息地？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
I think this is enough explanation for now. You wouldn't understand other highly sophisticated topics with specific terminology and all anyway.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
我觉得这就解释得够多了。反正那些涉及专业术语的高深话题，你也是听不懂的。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Oh! Do you have any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
哦！你还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
What do you think? Impressed at how much I know? Come by anytime when you have any more questions.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
你觉得怎么样？是不是被我渊博的知识折服了？以后有任何问题，随时欢迎来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Tikbalangs have a way to confuse travelers when they meet them by making them turn in circles regardless of wherever and how far they travel.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
邪魔马有一种让旅行者迷路的方法。当它们遇到旅行者时，会让对方无论走多远、朝哪个方向走，最后都只是在原地打转。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
They are mischievous creatures.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
它们是喜欢恶作剧的生物。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
But of course there is a way to stop their pranks. You know about the Inside-out Shirt? You can either wear your top inside-out.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
不过当然，也有办法阻止它们的恶作剧。你知道反穿的衬衫吗？你可以把上衣反着穿。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Or go on your way quietly without disrupting the Tikbalangs.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
或者，在不打扰邪魔马的情况下，安静地通过。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha ha ha~ But everyone knows adventurers are never quiet while they travel, right?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
哈哈哈哈~ 不过大家都知道，冒险者在旅行时从来都不会安静，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Never...
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
从来不会...

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
They say Tikbalangs have several distinctions.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
据说邪魔马有几个显著的特征。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
First, they are very tall ^AAAAAA(tsk... wish I were tall)^000000 and have skinny, imbalanced legs and arms. Looks almost like a human but their knees are higher than their upper body when they sit down.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
首先，它们非常高^AAAAAA（啧...真希望我也这么高）^000000，四肢细长且比例失调。看起来很像人类，但坐下时膝盖会高于上半身。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Second, is the standard characteristics acknowledged by the association. They have heads and feet like a horse.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
其次，是协会公认的标准特征。它们拥有马一样的头和脚。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
So with all these appearance traits, Tikbalang is sometimes called the creature from hell.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
综合这些外貌特征，邪魔马有时也被称为来自地狱的生物。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
There are several fun rumors about Tikbalangs.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
关于邪魔马，还有几个有趣的传闻。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
One of them is about Tikbalangs being the guardians of some kingdom that worships nature.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
其中一个传闻是，邪魔马是某个崇拜自然的王国的守护者。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
So the Tikbalangs will trick travelers who come with bad intentions to the kingdom by making them travel in circles.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
所以，邪魔马会戏弄那些怀着恶意来到王国的旅行者，让他们在原地打转。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Another rumor is that people around here say that 'if it rains on a clear day, then it must be Tikbalang's wedding day'.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
另一个传闻是，这里的人常说：'如果大晴天突然下雨，那一定是邪魔马在举行婚礼'。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
The association speculates that sayings like 'it rains on Bathory's wedding day' or 'it rains on Moonlight Flower's wedding day' might have derived from the Tikbalang's saying.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
协会推测，像'巴托里结婚那天会下雨'或'月夜猫结婚那天会下雨'这样的说法，可能都源自关于邪魔马的这句谚语。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Lastly, ancient fairy tales say that Tikbalangs can transform into human form or even make themselves transparen't but nobody has verified this yet.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
最后，古老的神话传说邪魔马可以变成人形，甚至能让自己变得透明，但至今还没有人证实过这一点。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Tikbalangs usually live in dark, busy places where there aren't many people around.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
邪魔马通常栖息在阴暗、繁忙且人烟稀少的地方。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Hmm... For example, they are known to live beneath bridges, in banana and bamboo forests and beneath large trees.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
嗯... 比如，它们据说住在桥下、香蕉林和竹林里，或者大树底下。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
And this is just my opinion but wouldn't you agree that they are living in dark places because it is easier to play pranks on people?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
这只是我个人的看法，但你不觉得它们住在阴暗的地方，是因为那样更容易捉弄人吗？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha ha. Do you now know how great I am?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
哈哈哈。现在你知道我有多厉害了吧？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Oh! Isn't this material to make 'Tikbalang Belt' used to tame Tikbalangs?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
哦！这不是用来驯服邪魔马的“邪魔马腰带”的材料吗？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
The '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' is used to capture Tikbalangs without the hassle. But that doesn't mean it's 100% successful. Interested? Do you want me to make one for you?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
“^F80835邪魔马腰带^000000”可以用来轻松捕捉邪魔马，但这并不意味着成功率是100%。有兴趣吗？要我帮你做一个吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I'm interested.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有兴趣

scripts.text: No, I can capture one myself.
scripts.translation: 不，我可以自己捕捉

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Yiiiiiiiiiiii! Yap!
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
耶耶耶耶耶耶！好耶！

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
The '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' is already created.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
“^F80835邪魔马腰带^000000”已经制作好了。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
You? Ha... You can try if you want to.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
你？哈... 如果你想试试的话，尽管试吧。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
There is the easy way and the hard way to capture Tikbalangs. Which one do you prefer?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
捕捉邪魔马有简单的方法，也有困难的方法。你更喜欢哪一种？

scripts.text: Easy way.
scripts.translation: 简单的方法

scripts.text: Hard way.
scripts.translation: 困难的方法

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha. I've come up with the easy way myself.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
哈哈。简单的方法可是我自己想出来的。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Bring me 3 Tikbalang's Thick Spines and 5 Lesser Agimats to make a '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' to help you easily capture Tikbalangs.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
给我3个邪魔马的厚脊椎骨和5个小型护身符，我来制作一条“^F80835邪魔马腰带^000000”，帮你轻松捕捉邪魔马。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha ha ha ha!
I will say it again.
It's 3 Tikbalang's Thick Spines and 5 Lesser Agimats. Understood?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
我再重复一遍。
是3个邪魔马的厚脊椎骨和5个小型护身符。听明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
It's easy for me but I don't know about you.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
对我来说这很简单，但不知道对你来说如何。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Tikbalangs have a sharp, pointy mane behind their neck.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
邪魔马的脖子后面有一撮尖锐的鬃毛。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Of course! There are several of them but you must get the three thickest ones.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
当然！那里有好几根，但你必须拿到最粗的三根。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
These three manes are the weak point. You can tame a Tikbalang by pulling the manes out.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
这三根鬃毛是它的弱点。你可以把鬃毛拔出来，从而驯服邪魔马。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Now let me explain how to pull these manes out.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
现在让我来解释一下如何拔出这些鬃毛。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
You must fly like a butterfly and land like a bee on the back of a Tikbalang.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
你必须像蝴蝶一样飞舞，像蜜蜂一样落在邪魔马的背上。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Of course! The Tikbalang will get mad and try to shake you off with all its might.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
当然！邪魔马会生气，并竭尽全力试图把你甩下去。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
All you have to do is hold on until the Tikbalang gets exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
你只需要坚持住，直到邪魔马精疲力竭。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Then again, itll take 4 days and 3 nights for Tikbalangs to get tired since they are strong creatures. But let's not focus on too much details.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
不过话说回来，因为邪魔马是强大的生物，它们需要4天3夜才会感到疲惫。但我们不必纠结于这些细节。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Which means!! The Tikbalang is already tamed.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗专家]
也就是说！！邪魔马已经被驯服了。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
I will upgrade your armor if you bring one that holds enormous power.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
如果你带来蕴含巨大力量的装备，我会为你升级它。

scripts.text: What kind of equipment do upgrade?
scripts.translation: 升级什么类型的装备？

scripts.text: What are the required materials?
scripts.translation: 需要什么材料？

scripts.text: What will it become after an upgrade?
scripts.translation: 升级后会变成什么？

scripts.text: Please upgrade this.
scripts.translation: 请升级这个。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Your questions are too simple, but!
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
你的问题太简单了，但是！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Are also important.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
这些也很重要。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^7B4772Bakonawa Scale Armor^000000 made from the scales of the Bakonawa monster known to swallow the moon.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
^7B4772食月者鳞甲^000000，由以吞食月亮闻名的魔物巴库暴龙的鳞片制成。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Light but sturdy ^7B4772Kalasag^000000 made from rattan that grows wild around Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
^7B4772卡拉沙矩盾^000000，由生长在马来港周围的野生藤条制成，轻便且坚固。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^7B4772Buwaya Sack Cloth^000000 made from the sack of the man-eating alligator Buwaya.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
^7B4772宝箱巨鳄披肩^000000，由食人魔物宝箱巨鳄的囊袋制成。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^7B4772Bangungot Boots of Nightmare^000000 imbued with the hatred and vengeance of the monster Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
^7B4772噩梦的般滚勾特长靴^000000，蕴含了魔物般滚勾特的仇恨与复仇之力。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
As just mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
正如刚才所说。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
I will make powerful armor out of ONLY the strongest armor dropped from fearful monsters.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
我只用从可怕魔物身上掉落的、最强力的装备来制作强力护甲。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Learned well.
Seems you learned that there is no such thing as free in life.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
学得不错。
看来你已经明白了，这世上没有免费的午餐。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
First thing to remember is that the object to upgrade must be strong itself. At least strong enough to endure ^FF0000+9 Refinement^000000.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
首先要记住的是，要升级的物品本身必须足够坚固。至少得能承受^FF0000+9精炼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Next is true strength that only comes out of power obtained naturally. I need ^FF000020 Ancient Grudges^000000 for protection from evil while Im refining.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
其次是只有从自然力量中获得的真正强度。我需要^FF000020个古代的咒符^000000，以便在精炼时抵御邪恶。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
When a ^FF0000+9 Refined Strong armor^000000 is combined with ^FF000020 Ancient Grudges^000000 for protection!!
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
当^FF0000+9精炼的强力护甲^000000与^FF000020个古代的咒符^000000结合以提供保护时！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
You get a completely new and improved armor from old scraps.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
你就能从旧废料中获得一件全新且升级的护甲。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Always look forward to this.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
我总是期待这一刻。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Listen, because this is a very important question.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
听好了，因为这是一个非常重要的问题。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
It won't matter if I say it more than a 100 times that upgraded armor is powerful.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
无论我说多少遍，升级后的护甲都很强大，这并不重要。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Unless the one that holds it doesn't believe it is! Ask about what has changed and decide for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
除非持有它的人不相信这一点！问问自己有什么改变，然后自己做出决定！

scripts.text: There is no more.
scripts.translation: 没有了

scripts.text: Bakonawa Scale Armor
scripts.translation: 食月者鳞甲

scripts.text: Kalasag
scripts.translation: 卡拉沙矩盾

scripts.text: Buwaya Sack Cloth
scripts.translation: 宝箱巨鳄披肩

scripts.text: Bangungot Boots of Nightmare
scripts.translation: 噩梦的般滚勾特长靴

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Looks like you ran out of questions.
Don't forget. You'll have to give up something to gain something.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
看来你的问题问完了。
别忘了。要想得到某些东西，就必须放弃某些东西。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
The Bakonawa Scale Armor adds +1 to all stats for all jobs which is overall great armor for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
食月者鳞甲为所有职业的所有属性提供+1加成，是一件对所有人都很棒的护甲。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
But I'm sure the inner you thinks this isn't enough.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
但我相信，你内心深处觉得这还不够。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
That is why +2 can be added to all stats and an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
因此，如果进行升级，所有属性可以额外增加+2，并且可以插入一张卡片。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Kalasag is a good shield to reduce damage from boss monsters by 1% per 3 refinements.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
卡拉沙矩盾是一件不错的盾牌，每精炼3次，可以减少来自Boss魔物的1%伤害。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
But not enough. Can't believe that a shield doesnt have a place to equip a card.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
但这还不够。真不敢相信盾牌竟然没有地方可以装备卡片。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
That is why I can add an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
因此，如果进行升级，我可以为你的装备额外增加一个卡片插槽。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
The Buwaya Sack Cloth offers healing capacity and healing item effect increase by 1% per 3 refinements. Not to mention it reduces 10% damage from Water, Earth, Fire, and Wind elemental monsters.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
宝箱巨鳄披肩每精炼3次，治疗效果和治疗物品效果增加1%。此外，它还能减少来自水、地、火、风属性魔物10%的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
But not enough. Can't believe that these clothes don't come with a place to equip a card. Everyone knows that clothes should have Raydric on them!
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
但这还不够。真不敢相信衣服竟然没有地方可以装备卡片。大家都知道，衣服上应该插着幽灵剑士卡片！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Don't worry! I can add an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
别担心！如果进行升级，我可以为你的装备额外增加一个卡片插槽。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
The Bangungot Boots of Nightmare increases +1 MDEF per 1 refinement and speed increases starting at 14 refinement and above.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
噩梦的般滚勾特长靴每精炼1次，魔法防御力增加+1，并且从精炼+14开始增加移动速度。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
The speed increase effect from shoes like Moonlight Flower Shoes and Sleipnir items are out of reach for ordinary people.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
像月夜猫之靴或史雷普尼尔之靴那样的加速效果，对普通人来说遥不可及。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
But of course, +14 refinement isn't easy but there is an easy way to get it.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
当然，精炼+14并不容易，但有一个简单的方法可以实现。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
By upgrading your shoes, you can get speed increase starting from +12 refinement!
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
通过升级你的鞋子，你从精炼+12开始就能获得加速效果！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
And it doesn't end there!!
I will also put in an extra slot in your socket to add a card.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
而且不止于此！！
我还会在你的装备上额外增加一个插槽来插入卡片。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
However, you'll have to give up something to gain something.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
不过，想要得到某些东西，就必须放弃某些东西。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^0000FFEquipping the Kalasag, Buwaya Sack Cloth, Bakonawa Scale Armor, and Bangungot Boots of Nightmare all at once will lose the ^FF0000Set Effects^0000FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
^0000FF同时装备卡拉沙矩盾、宝箱巨鳄披肩、食月者鳞甲和噩梦的般滚勾特长靴，将会失去^FF0000套装效果^0000FF。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Think it through. Next question?
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
好好考虑一下。还有下一个问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Good!
You've brought the materials, right?
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！很好！
你带来材料了吗？

scripts.text: Oh... sorry...
Preparations are complete!!
scripts.translation: 准备完毕！！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Oh no!!
I will need an light but sturdy armor with an refinement of +9 or greater and 20 Ancient Grudges!!
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
糟糕！！
我需要一件精炼+9或更高、轻便且坚固的护甲，以及20个古代的咒符！！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
You said all preparations are done and you give me this?! I need at least 20 Ancient Grudges to refine your item.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
你说准备都做好了，却给我这个？！我至少需要20个古代的咒符来精炼你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
So what armor will it be?
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
那么，你要升级的是哪件护甲？

scripts.text: Bakonawa Scale Armor
scripts.translation: 食月者鳞甲

scripts.text: Kalasag
scripts.translation: 卡拉沙矩盾

scripts.text: Buwaya Sack Cloth
scripts.translation: 宝箱巨鳄披肩

scripts.text: Bangungot Boots of Nightmare
scripts.translation: 噩梦的般滚勾特长靴

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
You should wear the equipment to upgrade and not come without it on you.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
你应该穿着要升级的装备过来，而不是空手来。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
What is this! You said you wanted to upgrade {0} but why are you giving me this? You should be wearing {1}.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
这是怎么回事！你说你想升级{0}，但为什么给我这个？你应该穿着{1}。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
No, the sturdiness of this item has not been tested yet. It'll have to be at least +9 refined for me to say, 'Oh this is pretty sturdy armor.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
不，这件装备的坚固程度还没有经过测试。至少需要精炼到+9，我才能说“哦，这件护甲相当坚固”。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Looks like you did your homework! Don't see a flaw! Then I have one question to ask before I start refinement.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
看来你做了功课！我看不到任何瑕疵！那么，在我开始精炼之前，我有一个问题要问你。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^0000FFOnce your item is refined, the refinement level will be ^FF00000^0000FF and the item will be upgraded.^000000 You get this part?
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
^0000FF一旦你的装备精炼完成，精炼等级将变为 ^FF00000^0000FF，并且装备会得到升级。^000000 你明白这一点吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
What? You didn't know this? Then, read through my instructions and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
什么？你不知道这个？那么，请仔细阅读我的说明，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Good. Next question. Once refinement is done,
^0000FFEquipping the Kalasag, Buwaya Sack Cloth, Bakonawa Scale Armor, and Bangungot Boots of Nightmare all at once will lose the ^FF0000Set Effects^0000FF.^000000
Do you understand this point?
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
很好。下一个问题。精炼完成后，
^0000FF同时装备卡拉沙矩盾、宝箱巨鳄披肩、食月者鳞甲和噩梦的般滚勾特长靴将会失去 ^FF0000套装效果^0000FF。^000000
你理解这一点吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
What? You didn't know this? Then, read through my instructions and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
什么？你不知道这个？那么，请仔细阅读我的说明，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Awesome! Then let's start refining {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
太棒了！那么让我们开始精炼{0}吧。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Pow!! Wow!! Flip... flop!
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
砰！！哇！！翻...翻！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
BAM!!
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
轰！！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Ha ha. Perfect.
Congratulations. Your armor is better than ever.
scripts.translation:
[巴亚尼]
哈哈。完美。
恭喜。你的护甲比以往任何时候都要好。

scripts.text: - From the wary looks on the guard's face, it is obvious he is at alert at the sight of you. He won't intimidate you but seems he won't even deal with you either. -
scripts.translation: - 从卫兵警惕的眼神中可以看出，他看到你时处于警戒状态。他不会抄袭你，但似乎也不打算理会你。 -

scripts.text: - Would there be anyone to talk to in the village? -
scripts.translation: - 村庄里会有人愿意和我说话吗？ -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
There is a small area called ^3131FFBaryo Mahiwaga^000000 outside of Port Malaya.
The place is closer to mother nature than what we have here.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
在马来港外面有一个叫 ^3131FFBaryo Mahiwaga^000000 的小区域。
那里的地方比我们这里更接近大自然。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
On the other hand, the area is full of fierce monsters. Take care of yourself while you're traveling there.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
另一方面，那个区域充满了凶猛的魔物。你在那里旅行时要小心。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
There are more people leaving the village secretly these days. Are you also heading for the woods to look for the mysterious treasure?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
最近有更多村民秘密离开村庄。你也是要去树林里寻找神秘的宝物吗？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I take that back. On second thought, I don't think a weakling like you would even dare to go there.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
我收回刚才的话。仔细想想，我觉得像你这样的弱者甚至不敢去那里。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You'd better hold tight to your mommy's hand if you want to go outside of Port Malaya or else the monsters will eat you alive. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
如果你想离开马来港，最好紧紧抓住你母亲的手，否则魔物会把你活活吃掉。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Is that why there are more outsiders here these days? Now don't be sneaky and a know-it-all. How would you know if I'd offered to take you around?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这就是为什么最近这里的外来者变多了吗？别鬼鬼祟祟的，也别装懂。你怎么知道我会提议带你四处看看呢？

scripts.text: Treasure?
scripts.translation: 宝物？

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Are you ignoring me? Bah.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你在无视我吗？哼。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Oh, so you aren't here to look for treasure?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
哦，所以你不是来找宝物的？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I hear people are talking about a mysterious treasure hidden deep in the woods.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
我听说有人在议论，说森林深处藏着一笔神秘的宝物。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Do you see that group of people over there? They always gather and talk about it every day.
Try talking to them if you are interested, too.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你看到那边那群人了吗？他们每天都聚在一起谈论这件事。
如果你也感兴趣，不妨去跟他们聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
So the talk about treasure was just a rumor? I'm not asking because I want to be rich overnight. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
原来关于宝物的传闻只是谣言啊？我可不是想一夜暴富才问的。哈哈。

scripts.text: - Look at you warily while whispering to each other. -
scripts.translation: - 警惕地看着你，并互相低声交谈。 -

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
No, I heard they got lost in the woods.
Who would hide such a treasure from a small village like ours?
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
不，我听说他们是在森林里迷路了。
谁会在这种小村庄附近藏这么贵重的宝物呢？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Could it been a monster? My grandma said there is a dragon with a huge head living deep inside the woods.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
难道是魔物？我老奶奶说，森林深处住着一只头特别大的龙。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
No. Listen to me.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
不。听我说。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
You all know ^3131FFTotoy^000000? The kid living at the ^3131FFInn^000000.
Well, did you know Totoy came back from the woods recently?
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
你们都知道^3131FF托托伊^000000吧？就是住在^3131FF旅店^000000里的那个小孩。
你们知道吗，托托伊最近刚从森林里回来？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Really??? He came back alive?
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
真的？？？他活着回来了？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Yeah. But the strange part is that the troublemaker ^3131FFTotoy^000000 now quietly stays home and never comes out.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
是啊。但奇怪的是，那个捣蛋鬼^3131FF托托伊^000000现在总是安安静静地待在家里，再也不出来了。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Don't you get it? Totoy must have found the treasure.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
你们没看出来吗？托托伊肯定是找到了宝物。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
What!!!! Then ^3131FFTotoy^000000 is rich now?
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
什么！！那^3131FF托托伊^000000现在变富了？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
I don't think so.
I saw ^3131FFTotoy^000000 come back home, but Totoy wasn't carrying anything.
But then, I must have missed it because I ran back home right away.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
我不这么认为。
我看到^3131FF托托伊^000000回家时，他手里什么都没拿。
不过，也许是我没注意到，因为我当时急着跑回家了。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Then what is ^3131FFTotoy^000000 doing at home?
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
那^3131FF托托伊^000000在家干什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
I think Totoy is making a plan to bring the treasure back without us knowing it.
To have the whole treasure for himself, that greedy kid.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
我觉得托托伊是在策划怎么把宝物运回来，又不让我们知道。
他想独吞整笔宝物，那个贪婪的小孩。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Is that true?
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
是真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
The treasure would be in better hands with me ~
I would clean it every day so it shined and would use it as a beautiful ornament. Ah~~~
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
宝物交给我保管更好吧～
我会每天把它擦得闪闪发光，把它当作漂亮的装饰品。啊～～～

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Then how about we talk to ^3131FFTotoy^000000 to spill the beans on where the treasure is?
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
那我们要不要去问问^3131FF托托伊^000000，让他说出宝物的位置？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Wow. That is an awesome idea. No wonder you're the leader!
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
哇。真是个好主意。难怪你是首领！

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
But will ^3131FFTotoy^000000 give up the information easily?
Because Totoy was sneaky enough to think of getting away with taking the whole treasure.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
但是^3131FF托托伊^000000会轻易交出情报吗？
毕竟他狡猾到能想到独吞整笔宝物。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Then we should convince ^3131FFTotoy^000000 to tell us where the treasure is instead of looking for it ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
那我们还是去说服^3131FF托托伊^000000，让他告诉我们宝物的位置，而不是自己去找吧。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Ah~~~ it is so hard to get something pretty these days ~~~!!!!
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅港村民]
啊～～～现在想弄到漂亮的东西真难～～～！！！！

scripts.text: - Better pay a visit to this Totoy to get more information about the treasure. -
scripts.translation: - 最好去拜访一下托托伊，获取更多关于宝物的情报。 -

scripts.text: - People are talking with serious faces. -
scripts.translation: - 人们正一脸严肃地交谈着。 -

scripts.text: - See someone shaky with dopey eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 看到一个人眼神呆滞，浑身发抖。 -

scripts.text: - See someone shaky with dopey eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 看到一个人眼神呆滞，浑身发抖。 -

scripts.text: Tap him on the shoulder.
scripts.translation: 拍他的肩膀

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Wah! No! Go away! Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
哇！不！走开！别管我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, are you alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Huh... you're a person? Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
嗯...你是个人类？你是谁？

scripts.text: - He looks you straight in the face but doesn't seem to recognize you. -
scripts.translation: - 他直直地看着你的脸，但似乎并不认识你。 -

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Who's there?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
谁在那儿？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am {1}. You are Totoy, right? People say you've found a treasure. Is it true?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是{1}。你是托托伊，对吧？听说你发现了一笔宝物，是真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
What treasure?
I can't see. I'm blinded. Please help me. I'm tired and frustrated.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
什么宝物？
我看不见。我瞎了。请帮帮我。我很累，也很沮丧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Can't talk long. I need to heal my eyes first.
There should be some ^3131FFGreen Potion^000000 left inside the drawer. Will you take it out for me?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
没法聊太久。我得先治治我的眼睛。
抽屉里应该还有^3131FF绿色药水^000000。你能帮我拿出来吗？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Can't talk long. I need to heal my eyes first.
There should be some ^3131FFGreen Potion^000000 left inside the drawer. Will you get it for me?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
没法聊太久。我得先治治我的眼睛。
抽屉里应该还有^3131FF绿色药水^000000。你能帮我拿一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Hello? Hey, are you still there? What happened to the Green Potion? Jeez, this is driving me crazy.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
喂？嘿，你还在吗？绿色药水怎么样了？天哪，这快把我逼疯了。

scripts.text: Hand over the Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 交出绿色药水

scripts.text: Do not hand over the potion.
scripts.translation: 不交出药水

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Did you really leave? Hey! Darn!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
你真的走了吗？嘿！该死！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Gulp, gulp...
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
咕嘟，咕嘟...

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I can see!! My eyes work!!!
Yay! I feel better now!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我看见了！我的眼睛好了！
耶！我感觉好多了！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Wow! You look better than you sounded. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
哇！你看起来比听起来好多了。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
But what did you say? Something about a treasure?
Did you say I found a treasure?
What is that about?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
不过你刚才说什么来着？好像提到了宝物？
你说我找到了宝物？
那是怎么回事？

scripts.text: Tell him what the people are talking about.
scripts.translation: 告诉他人们在议论什么

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
WHAT?
Puhaha! Totoy is rich! Became rich overnight! Chief Ed!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
什么？
噗哈哈！托托伊发财了！一夜暴富！首领艾德！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Sorry but I went to the woods to collect bugs. Wish I saw a treasure while I was at it. Hmph!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
抱歉，我去树林里抓虫子了。要是顺便能看到宝物就好了。哼！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I did go deep in the woods because I wasn't getting anywhere with collecting bugs. But who would have thought I'd get into this mess?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我确实深入了树林，因为抓虫子没什么进展。但谁能想到我会陷入这种麻烦呢？

scripts.text: What Totoy saw
scripts.translation: 托托伊看到了什么

scripts.text: About bugs
scripts.translation: 关于虫子

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I only wanted to show people my collection of cute bugs. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我只是想给大家看看我收集的可爱虫子。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Dropping ice or bugs down peoples clothes is just like a daily greeting, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
把冰块或虫子塞进别人衣服里，就像日常问候一样，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I love to see people run around the village like they are in a marathon. He he.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我喜欢看人们在村子里跑来跑去，就像在跑马拉松一样。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I thought people wouldn't run away because of an ordinary bug so I went in the woods with Ed.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我以为人们不会因为一只普通的虫子就逃跑，所以我和艾德一起去了树林。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ah, Ed is my cute puppy. He's very nice and cuddly. My best friend in the whole wide world.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
啊，艾德是我可爱的小狗。它非常温顺可爱。是我在这个世界上最要好的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed usually barks a lot but I should have looked around when he barked and pulled on my sleeves.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德平时总是叫个不停，但我本该在它叫唤并拉扯我袖子的时候四处看看的。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
- Totoy bends over and whispers to you as if walls have ears. -
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
- 托托伊弯下腰，仿佛墙壁有耳朵一样，对你低声耳语。 -

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
There was a monster with a mouth the size of a house right behind me.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我身后有一只嘴巴像房子那么大的魔物。

scripts.text: A monster?!
scripts.translation: 魔物？！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Shssh! Be quiet. I've never seen a mouth that big before. It was full of a river of saliva flowing out of spiky teeth. Just the thought of it makes me want to hide.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
嘘！小声点。我从没见过那么大的嘴巴。里面全是尖牙，还流着像河流一样的口水。光是想想我就想躲起来。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
The scariest part is that the monster has two heads. You won't believe it till you see it.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
最可怕的是，那只魔物有两个头。你不亲眼看到绝对不敢相信。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed bit the monsters leg with all his might to let me get away. But I don't know what happened to him afterwards. Sniff~
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德拼尽全力咬住魔物的腿，好让我逃掉。但我不知道它后来怎么样了。吸溜~

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
That's when I hurt my eye. To tell you the truth I don't even remember how I came back.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
就在那时，我的眼睛受伤了。说实话，我甚至不记得自己是怎么回来的。

scripts.text: About the monster
scripts.translation: 关于那只魔物

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Don't know. It was the first time I saw a monster like that. Who could live to tell the story?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
不知道。那是我第一次见到那种魔物。谁能活着回来讲述这段经历呢？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Wait, maybe the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000 might know about the monster. They say he fought with all sorts of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
等等，也许^FF0000狩猎大师^000000会知道那只魔物。据说他和各种各样的魔物都交过手。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I need some time alone. I need to make a tombstone for Ed. If you want to meet the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000, you'll find him near the Weapon Store.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我需要一个人静静。我要给艾德立块墓碑。如果你想见^FF0000狩猎大师^000000，他在武器店附近。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
And tell everyone else to stop spreading rumors about treasure. They don't know what I went through. Sniff! I'm going to put Ancient Worms in everyones clothes!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
还有，告诉其他人别再散布关于宝物的谣言了。他们根本不知道我经历了什么。吸溜！我要把狂暴蜈蚣塞进每个人的衣服里！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I have to make a grave for Ed. My loyal friend, Ed...
If you want to meet the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000, you'll find him near the Weapon Store.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我得给艾德挖个墓。我忠诚的朋友，艾德...
如果你想见^FF0000狩猎大师^000000，他在武器店附近。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed!! Eeeeeddddddd!!!
Can't believe you gave your life to save me. Wail!!!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德！！艾德！！！！！！
真不敢相信你为了救我献出了生命。哇哇哇！！

scripts.text: - Totoy can't be lying when he's crying his heart out like this. -
scripts.translation: - 托托伊哭得如此伤心，他不可能在说谎。 -

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Where I saw the monster?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我见到那只魔物的地方？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Um... Hmm...
I was so busy running away...
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
嗯... 唔...
我当时只顾着逃命了...

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
It was really deep in the woods. Probably even past Baryo Mahiwaga.
I think I heard the sound of ^3131FFFlowing Water^000000. A large whooshing sound. This is all I remember.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
那是在很深的树林里。可能甚至超过了巴里奥·马希瓦加。
我记得听到了^3131FF流水^000000的声音。很大的哗哗声。我只记得这些。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Poor Ed. I miss Ed. Wail!!!!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
可怜的艾德。我想念艾德。哇哇哇哇！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Poor Ed. I miss Ed. Wail!!!!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
可怜的艾德。我想念艾德。哇哇哇哇！！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed!!
Ed!!! You're alive!!!
You've come back!!! I'm so happy!!!!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德！！
艾德！！！你活着！！！
你回来了！！！我太高兴了！！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Did you bring Ed back?
Thank you so much!
You didn't see the monster, did you?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
是你把艾德带回来的吗？
太感谢你了！
你没看到那只魔物，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The monster is called Buwaya. I told the Guard about the monster. You better not go near the place again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那只魔物叫宝箱巨鳄。我已经告诉卫兵关于那只魔物的事了。你最好别再靠近那个地方了。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Okay!
He he. Ed, the woods are too dangerous so we can't go there for bugs anymore.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
好的！
呵呵。艾德，森林太危险了，我们不能再去找虫子了。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Whimper...

[Totoy]
But I'm sure we can find a way to keep our reputation with other creepy stuff!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
但我相信我们一定能找到其他可怕的东西来维持我们的名声！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Anyway, thanks for bringing my best friend back.
I don't have much but would like to thank you. Wait, let me see what's inside my drawer. He he-
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
总之，谢谢你把我最好的朋友带回来。
我没什么东西，但还是想感谢一下你。等等，让我看看抽屉里有什么。呵呵-

scripts.text:
- Wait!! -
- You have too many items on you. -
- Cannot receive the item. -
- Clean up your items -
- And please try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你身上的物品太多了。 -
- 无法接收物品。 -
- 请清理你的物品 -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text: - Totoy goes through the drawer, turning it upside down. Making a mess of the room. -
scripts.translation: - 托托伊翻遍了抽屉，把抽屉倒过来。把房间弄得一团糟。 -

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Found it!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
找到了！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Here. My mom gave it to me but I don't know how to use it... He he.
I hope you can use it.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
给你。这是我妈妈给我的，但我不知道怎么用... 呵呵。
希望你能用上它。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Visit me when you get bored!
Just don't ask about the treasure again~!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
无聊的时候来找我玩吧！
只是别再问关于宝藏的事了~！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Woof woof woof!!!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪汪！！！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed went out to play so I'm alone.
Would there be something awesome to surprise people with?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德出去玩了，所以只有我一个人在家。
有没有什么厉害的东西可以让人大吃一惊呢？

scripts.text: - You look for the Green Potion in Totoys drawer. -
scripts.translation: - 你在托托伊的抽屉里寻找绿色药水。 -

scripts.text: - Rummaging, fumbling. -
scripts.translation: - 翻找，摸索。 -

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? I only see an empty potion bottle.
Does this mean I have to get the potion myself? That Totoy is really a troublemaker.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？我只看到一个空药瓶。
这意味着我得自己去拿药水吗？那个托托伊真是个麻烦制造者。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Oh! Ho! Ho!
I am the Master of Hunting! I'm not afraid of anything with just one exception! I'm afraid of outsiders...
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
哦！呵！呵！
我是狩猎大师！除了一个例外，我什么都不怕！我害怕外人...

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Yo! Ho! Ho!
I went all the way to Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to defeat the Angry Minorous.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
哟！呵！呵！
我一路来到卢恩·米德加兹王国，击败了愤怒的米洛斯。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
And I succeeded in killing Muka, the one with the voice of a demon that disturbs the peace of the world.
Wow! He was really tough. I'm starting to sweat just thinking of him.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
我成功杀死了摩卡，那个用恶魔的声音扰乱世界和平的家伙。
哇！他真的很强。光是想想我就开始出汗了。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Yo! You look like you have a few battle stories yourself. Have you ever seen a Minorous? Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
哟！你看起来也有几段战斗故事。你见过米洛斯吗？哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
So you came here to learn all about my excellent hunting skills? Or to ask me to publish an essay on Master of Hunting? Ho!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
所以你是来这里想学习我高超的狩猎技巧？还是想让我发表一篇关于狩猎大师的文章？呵！

scripts.text: About Totoys monster
scripts.translation: 关于托托伊的魔物

scripts.text: Interrupt.
scripts.translation: 打断

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Oh? Hey! Where are you going?!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
哦？嘿！你要去哪里？！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
You say someone saw the monster?
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
你说有人看到了那只魔物？

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
There are many monsters in and out of Port Malaya. What is so special about this one?
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
马来港内外有很多魔物。这只有什么特别的吗？

scripts.text: About a monster with two heads
scripts.translation: 关于一只双头魔物

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Ho! A monster with two heads, you say? Are you kidding? Where on earth is there a monster with two heads?!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
呵！双头魔物？你在开玩笑吧？世界上哪里会有双头魔物？！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
The kid must have been scared by a Condor or something.
There's a saying that someone surprised to see a Permeter, will also be surprised to see a peach tree. Ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
那小孩肯定是被秃鹰之类的吓到了。
俗话说，看到果树龟会惊讶的人，看到桃树也会惊讶。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
You shouldn't lie to an adult. I understand you want the Master of Huntings attention. Ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
你不该对大人撒谎。我知道你想引起狩猎大师的注意。哈哈！

scripts.text: I will prove it.
scripts.translation: 我会证明的

scripts.text: Suspicious of Totoy.
scripts.translation: 怀疑托托伊

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Kids tell stories for their own reasons. I'm sure Totoy is the same.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
小孩讲故事总有他们的理由。我相信托托伊也是。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Oh! Really? Bring proof if you really think the kid is telling the truth.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
哦？真的吗？如果你真的认为那小孩说的是实话，就带来证据吧。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Every living thing leaves some kind of trace behind. You also leave behind traces and scents wherever you go. Especially in private places, I mean. He he!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
每个生物都会留下某种痕迹。你也会在你去过的地方留下痕迹和气味。尤其是在私密的地方，我是说。嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Try collecting 10 Animal Samples from where the kid saw the monster. I will look for traces of that monster from the samples.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
试着在那小孩看到魔物的地方收集10个动物样本。我会从样本中寻找那只魔物的痕迹。

嘿！把它放在那里，先去洗手再回来。带着这股臭味，连神明都不会保佑你。

scripts.translation:

快去告诉卫队长，宝箱巨鳄又活跃了。快！卫队长在村庄的北边。

I don't see anything.

[{0}]
我什么也没看到。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
It can't be! Look closer!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
不可能！仔细看！

scripts.text: - Felt something pointy with the end of your fingers. -
scripts.translation: - 指尖触到了尖锐的东西。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ouch!
What is this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎哟！
这是什么？

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Ho! This is huge! And so dense that it can easily scratch steel!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
嘿！这好大！而且密度极高，能轻易抓伤钢铁！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
This is ^3131FFBuwaya^000000's tooth!
How could this be!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
这是^3131FF宝箱巨鳄^000000的牙齿！
怎么会这样！

scripts.text: Buwaya?
scripts.translation: 宝箱巨鳄？

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Ah! Yes! Stop holding it up. It stinks. Go wash your hands.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
啊！对！别举着了。太臭了。去洗手。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Hmm. The monster the kid saw must be Buwaya. No doubt about it.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
嗯。那个小孩看到的魔物肯定是宝箱巨鳄。毫无疑问。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
I've heard that the wife of the neighbor of my grandfather's uncle on my mom's side was also killed by Buwaya.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
我听说，我母亲那边的祖父的叔叔的邻居的妻子，也是被宝箱巨鳄杀害的。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
They say no living thing is left after Buwaya passes by.
Totoy is one lucky kid. Wow!
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
据说宝箱巨鳄经过之后，不会留下任何活物。
托托伊真是幸运的孩子。哇！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Buwaya was inactive for a long time. Wonder if it was hibernating? Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
宝箱巨鳄已经很久没有活动了。不知道是不是在冬眠？嗯。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Now that I know that a monster like that is out there, I should be cautious, too.
Must tell the villagers not to go too deep into the woods.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
既然知道有那样的魔物在外面，我也得小心一点。
必须告诉村民们不要深入森林。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Please go and tell the Guard Leader that Buwaya is active again.
I will contact other hunters in the meantime and think of a plan to kill Buwaya.
scripts.translation:
[狩猎大师]
请去告诉卫队长，宝箱巨鳄又活动了。
在此期间，我会联系其他猎人，并制定一个消灭宝箱巨鳄的计划。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
We are busy as hell because of Bangungots servants attacking the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
因为噩梦死神般滚勾特的仆从袭击医院，我们忙得不可开交。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
We are doing our best in securing the safety of our village so please enjoy your stay in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
我们正在全力确保村庄的安全，所以请尽情在马来港享受您的停留。

scripts.text: Tell him about Buwaya.
scripts.translation: 告诉他关于宝箱巨鳄的事

scripts.text: Done with conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya? The merciless creature is back?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
宝箱巨鳄？那个无情的生物又回来了？

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
That's bad news. We are already short-handed by assigning everyone to fight off Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
这是个坏消息。我们已经人手不足，因为所有人都被派去对抗噩梦死神般滚勾特了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
And villagers need to go to the woods to collect fruits and vegetables.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
而且村民们需要去森林采集水果和蔬菜。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Hmm... will you be able to help Port Malaya?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
嗯...你能帮助马来港吗？

scripts.text: Leave it to me!
scripts.translation: 交给我吧！

scripts.text: I'm pretty busy myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己也挺忙的

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Really? That's no good. All the lives of the villagers will be at stake if we don't do something. How can a youth like you be so heartless. Are all outsiders like you? Hmph! Can't trust young people these days. Hmph.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
真的吗？这可不好。如果我们不采取行动，村民们的生命都将受到威胁。像你这样的年轻人怎么能如此冷酷无情。难道所有外人都像你们一样吗？哼！现在的年轻人真不可信。哼。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I knew I could count on you.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
我就知道可以指望你。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Good. I will trust you.
I need to know where Buwaya will likely appear in order to secure villagers living area.
Guess Buwayas nest will be the best bet.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
很好，我相信你。
为了保障村民们的居住区安全，我需要知道宝箱巨鳄可能出没的地方。
宝箱巨鳄的巢穴应该是最有可能的地点。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.
Then we will run to where the smoke bomb was shot.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
^3131FF到达该区域后，投掷一枚火烟瓶^000000。
然后我们会向火烟瓶投掷的方向赶去。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Then take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
那么，请多加小心，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.

scripts.translation:
