scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's first bring Ed to Totoy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们先把艾德带到托托伊那里吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
The Guard Leader gave you the location of Buwaya's cave.
This can't be happening.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
卫队长告诉了你宝箱巨鳄洞穴的位置。
这不可能发生。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I'm way out of men to assign to the Buwaya situation but well have to do something with what we got.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
我手下的兵力不足以应对宝箱巨鳄的情况，但我们必须用现有的人力做点什么。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Here, this is a symbol of our gratitude.
If you would like to help with Buwaya again, please look for me.
Hope you have a great journey.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
拿着，这是我们的谢礼。
如果你愿意再次协助处理宝箱巨鳄的问题，请随时来找我。
祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Hear Buwaya appeared from the depth of the Forest.
As everyone knows, all our manpower is dispatched to handle Bangungots servants attacking the hospital recently.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
听说宝箱巨鳄从普勒斯特深处出现了。
众所周知，我们所有的人力最近都调去应对噩梦死神般滚勾特的部下袭击医院了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
That is why we have no choice but to ask an outsider to help eliminate Buwaya.
They say Buwaya is a very strong and ugly monster with two heads.
Will you help us defeat Buwaya?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
所以我们别无选择，只能请求外人帮忙消灭宝箱巨鳄。
据说宝箱巨鳄是一种很强壮且丑陋的双头魔物。
你愿意帮助我们击败宝箱巨鳄吗？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 当然可以。

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya is known to be a very dangerous monster.
There is no shame in rejecting this request.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
宝箱巨鳄以极其危险著称。
拒绝这个请求并不丢人。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
This mission will be a dangerous one.
If you want to help get rid of Buwaya, you must be prepared.
Come back once you reach LV 130.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
这项任务非常危险。
如果你想帮忙消灭宝箱巨鳄，必须做好充分准备。
达到130级后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
According to the legend, Buwaya kidnaps people and puts them in the sack on its back and then eats them later.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
根据传说，宝箱巨鳄会绑架人类，把他们装进背上的袋子里，然后再吃掉他们。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Keep this in mind and be cautious at all times.
I recommend asking trustful colleagues for help.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
请记住这一点，时刻保持警惕。
我建议找值得信赖的同伴一起行动。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
How is it going with the Buwaya situation?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
宝箱巨鳄的情况怎么样了？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放弃了。

scripts.text: Still fighting.
scripts.translation: 还在战斗中。

scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
宝箱巨鳄以极其危险著称。
拒绝这个请求并不丢人。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Can't believe you really got rid of Buwaya!
You aren't just any ordinary youth, aren't you? People of Port Malaya can now sleep at night.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
真不敢相信你真的消灭了宝箱巨鳄！
你可不是普通的年轻人啊。马来港的人们现在可以安心睡觉了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Good work.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
干得好。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I will not stand down until all of Port Malaya, including Baryo Mahiwaga, is safe from Buwaya. Promise to take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长]
在马来港包括Baryo Mahiwaga在内的所有地方都摆脱宝箱巨鳄的威胁之前，我不会撤职的。答应我，你要照顾好自己。

scripts.text: Bark bark!!
scripts.translation: 汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why is a dog here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里怎么会有只狗？

scripts.text: Look closely at the dog.
scripts.translation: 仔细看看这只狗

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Looks like a lost dog.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看起来像是只走丢的狗。

scripts.text: - Looked real hard at the dirty dog and noticed an old collar on its neck. -
scripts.translation: - 你仔细打量着这只脏兮兮的狗，发现它脖子上戴着一个旧项圈。 -

scripts.text: - The collar says, 'Forever with Totoy'. -
scripts.translation: - 项圈上写着“永远与托托伊在一起”。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you are Ed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来你是艾德啊。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You didn't get killed by Buwaya. You lucky little dog. Let's go back to your owner.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你居然没被宝箱巨鳄吃掉。真是只幸运的小狗。我们带你去找你的主人吧。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, before we go, do you happen to know where Buwaya's nest is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，在走之前，你知道宝箱巨鳄的巢穴在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Woof!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪！

scripts.text: - Ed is one smart dog and understood what you asked him. Ed started to bark towards the north. -
scripts.translation: - 艾德是一只很聪明的狗，它听懂了你的话。艾德开始朝北方吠叫。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Buwaya is over there!
Then I should shoot the smoke bomb here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
宝箱巨鳄在那边！
那我应该在这里发射火烟瓶。

scripts.text: - You take the smoke bomb out of your inventory and shoot towards the sky. -
scripts.translation: - 你从物品栏里拿出火烟瓶，向天空发射。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Job well done!
So Buwaya lives in remote place like this. I will make sure this information goes to the Guard Leader!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
干得好！
原来宝箱巨鳄住在这种偏僻的地方。我会确保把这个情报传达给卫队长！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I return Ed to Totoy first and then go see the Guard Leader?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我应该先把艾德送回给托托伊，然后再去找卫队长吗？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lets first bring Ed to Totoy and then go back to the Guard Leader.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先把艾德送回给托托伊，然后再去找卫队长吧。

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
Story of dragon that lives at a lake~
Story of an old lady
that became a dragon long ago~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
住在湖里的龙的故事~
一位老妇人
很久以前变成了龙~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
Waiting for the son that left for a foreign land,
my son will return
when that moon sets for the 90th time
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
等待那个去异国他乡的儿子，
当月亮落下第九十次时，
我的儿子就会回来

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The moon sets for the 89th,
The moon sets for the 90th,
The moon sets for the 191st...
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
月亮落下第八十九次，
月亮落下第九十次，
月亮落下第一百九十一次...

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
That moon has taken my son away~
That horrible thing
has swallowed my son,
and I will punish that moon~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
那轮月亮夺走了我的儿子~
那可怕的东西
吞掉了我的儿子，
我要惩罚那轮月亮~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The day the furious moon hides itself from sight,
the whole world will be flooded with rain
with all the villages and people facing death under water~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
当愤怒的月亮躲藏起来时，
整个世界将被雨水淹没，
所有的村庄和人民都将在水下走向死亡~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The old lady's curse made the moon furious~
Get rid of the old lady to calm the moon~
If only the old lady wasn't here, If only the old lady wasn't here...
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
老妇人的诅咒让月亮变得愤怒~
赶走老妇人，让月亮平息~
要是老妇人不在就好了，要是老妇人不在就好了...

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
I hear rumors~
The old lady threw herself into the lake~
the old lady, now turned into a dragon, will swallow the moon
and soon swallow the village too~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
我听到传闻~
老妇人跳进了湖里~
老妇人变成了龙，将吞掉月亮，
很快也会吞掉这个村庄~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
You say the legend is all a lie?
You mean my ancestors are all liars
and swindlers?
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
你说传说都是谎言？
你是说我祖先都是骗子
和欺诈者吗？

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
This village is built on an old legend
and history.
They are not the kind of people that will be shaken by
foolish words of an imbecile such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
这个村庄建立在古老的传说
和历史之上。
我们不是那种会被
像你这样的傻瓜的胡言乱语动摇的人。

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
Bakonawa that live at a lake,
story of an old lady that became a dragon.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
住在湖里的巴库暴龙，
一位老妇人变成了龙的故事。

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The son that was suppose to return after the moon sets for the 90th time
never did come back even after the moon had set for a few hundred times~
The moon has swallowed the old lady's son~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
那个本该在月亮落下第九十次时回来的儿子，
即使月亮落下几百次也没有回来~
月亮吞掉了老妇人的儿子~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The moon, the moon, you shall receive the old lady's curse~
The whole village was immersed in death
with rain and floods sent by the furious moon~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
月亮，月亮，你将承受老妇人的诅咒~
整个村庄都沉浸在死亡之中，
被愤怒的月亮带来的雨水和洪水淹没~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The moon, the moon, be still and be calm,
for the old lady is gone and she is no more~
The old lady has drowned in the lake~
She will transform into Bakonawa and come back...
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
月亮，月亮，请安静，请平息，
因为老妇人已经离去，不再存在~
老妇人淹死在湖里~
她将变成巴库暴龙回来...

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
...to swallow you and
punish the village soon~
The day the moon dies
is the day the village dies too~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
...吞掉你，
并很快惩罚这个村庄~
月亮死去的那一天，
也是村庄死去的那一天~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The legends are all a lie?
Why do you say such nonsense?
Is there nothing
that is important for you to protect?
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
传说都是谎言？
你为什么要说这种胡话？
难道没有什么
是你觉得重要并想要守护的吗？

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
Poor Bakonawa...
I would be happy
if she took a big bite out of someone like you!
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
可怜的巴库暴龙...
如果它能狠狠咬你一口，
我会很高兴的！

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Frightened Boy]
The vicious monster Bakonawa will soon come
to swallow the moon and take vengeance upon the village.
I'm scared, please help...
scripts.translation:
[受惊的男孩]
可怕的魔物巴库暴龙很快就要来了，
它将吞掉月亮，并向村庄复仇。
我很害怕，请帮帮我...

scripts.text:
[Frightened Boy]
The legend of Bakonawa is all a lie?
So that means Bakonawa doesn't exist?
I'm going to play with my friends at the lake later.
You told me it was all a lie right?
scripts.translation:
[受惊的男孩]
巴库暴龙的传说都是谎言？
那意思是巴库暴龙不存在？
我稍后要去湖边和朋友们玩。
你刚才说那都是谎言对吧？

scripts.text: - She seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 她似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
It is said that Bakonawa hates loud noises.
Pound the pot if you want to live!
scripts.translation:
[受惊的少女]
据说巴库暴龙讨厌巨大的噪音。
想活命就敲锅吧！

scripts.text: Hates loud noises?
scripts.translation: 讨厌巨大的噪音？

scripts.text: What is Bakonawa?
scripts.translation: 什么是巴库暴龙？

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
You already heard that the old lady
died and became Bakonawa, right?
scripts.translation:
[受惊的少女]
你已经听说那位老妇人死后变成了巴库暴龙，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
The legend has it that
the old lady had very keen hearing
because she was always focusing on
the returning of her traveling son.
scripts.translation:
[受惊的少女]
传说那位老妇人听力极佳，
因为她总是全神贯注地等待远行的儿子归来。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
So naturally, Bakonawa also
has very keen hearing.
The reason why everyone is banging
pots and pans is because of this.
scripts.translation:
[受惊的少女]
因此，巴库暴龙自然也有着极佳的听力。
大家之所以拼命敲打锅碗瓢盆，就是因为这个原因。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
It is a terrible monster that lives at a lake.
We are all trembling with fear
because we don't know when it might attack the village.
scripts.translation:
[受惊的少女]
它是一种栖息在湖中的可怕魔物。
我们都在恐惧中颤抖，
因为不知道它何时会袭击村庄。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
Some say that it is more obsessed with swallowing the moon
than attacking the village.
if that's the case, I wish it would just swallow the moon
and leave us alone.
scripts.translation:
[受惊的少女]
有人说它比起袭击村庄，
更痴迷于吞食月亮。
如果是这样，我希望它干脆吞掉月亮，
然后放过我们。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
The villagers hate you now.
You've been saying that legend of Bakonawa
is a lie and they are saying you are more of a monster
than Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[受惊的少女]
村民们现在很讨厌你。
你一直说巴库暴龙的传说是谎言，
他们说比起巴库暴龙，你更像是一个魔物。

scripts.text: - Old Fortune Teller seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 年老的占卜师似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
You must not hate Bakonawa.
The hate against it is only feeding its rage
to grow bigger.
scripts.translation:
[年老的占卜师]
你不应该憎恨巴库暴龙。
对它的憎恨只会助长它的怒火，
让怒火变得更大。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
To calm the dead lady's anger,
we annually hold a ceremony and prepare food.
But there seems to be no way to calm the
ever growing anger of the old lady.
scripts.translation:
[年老的占卜师]
为了平息那位逝者女士的愤怒，
我们每年都会举行仪式并准备食物。
但似乎没有任何办法能平息
那位老妇人日益增长的愤怒。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
The day is nearing. I can sense it.
Bakonawa will soon swallow the moon
and come to punish the village.
scripts.translation:
[年老的占卜师]
日子快到了，我能感觉到。
巴库暴龙很快会吞食月亮，
然后来惩罚这个村庄。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
How can you say the legend is a lie!
Because of you, the fury of Bakonawa
grew even larger!
If the village perishes,
it is all your fault!
scripts.translation:
[年老的占卜师]
你怎么能说传说是谎言！
因为你的缘故，巴库暴龙的怒火
变得更加猛烈了！
如果村庄毁灭了，
这都是你的错！

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 无法开始对话。你携带的物品太多了。-

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is something that needs to be done
but you look too fragile
to give me a hand.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
有一件事需要去做，
但你看起来太虚弱了，
无法帮我一把。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Come back when
your strength grows strong enough
to match Incubus.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
等你变得足够强壮，
能够匹敌恶魔侍者时，
再回来吧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The old lady has come back
to life as Bakonawa.
Soon she will come to take vengeance on the village.
We must calm her
if to prevent further destruction...
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
那位老妇人已经复活为巴库暴龙。
很快她就会回来向村庄复仇。
我们必须平息她的怒火，
以防止进一步的破坏...

scripts.text: Calm Bakonawa?
scripts.translation: 平息巴库暴龙？

scripts.text: Further destruction?
scripts.translation: 进一步的破坏？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The old lady faced an unjust death
because of villagers' selfishness.
She was a caring mother who loved her
son dearly.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
那位老妇人因为村民的自私而遭受了不公正的死亡。
她是一位慈爱的母亲，非常疼爱她的儿子。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
If we track the whereabouts of her son and hold a ritual
with her son's belongings,
her restless soul will be calmed
and she will spare us from destruction.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
如果我们追踪她儿子的下落，并用她儿子的遗物举行仪式，
她不安的灵魂就会得到平息，
她就会放过我们，不再破坏村庄。

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
It is no use sir!!
scripts.translation:
[村民们]
没用的，先生！！

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
You cannot stop the monster that way!
scripts.translation:
[村民们]
那样是阻止不了魔物的！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Of course, it will not be easy to track down the whereabouts of a person
who has been gone for a hundred years.
...
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
当然，要追踪一个失踪了百年的人的下落，绝非易事。
...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Still, don't you think
it is worth a try?
Please help us and save us from our misery.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
不过，您不觉得值得一试吗？
请帮帮我们，救我们脱离苦海。

scripts.text: It is no use.
scripts.translation: 没用的

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我会帮忙的。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Yes, you are also right.
You are up against not a human,
but a monster.
Still, I trust in that old lady's
good heart.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
是的，您说得也有道理。
您面对的不是人类，而是魔物。
不过，我依然相信那位老妇人的善心。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Will you do it?
According to the legend,
the old lady's son was limping
and was a traveling merchant that sold wooden dolls.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
您愿意去做吗？
根据传说，那位老妇人的儿子是个跛子，
是个贩卖木制玩偶的旅行商人。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is a ^FF0000Slate Piece^000000 he left.
But the piece is small and damaged,
its hard to identify it.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
他留下了一块^FF0000石板碎片^000000。
但碎片很小且已破损，
很难辨认。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
First, bring it to me.
Down along this path
you will meet my granddaughter near the port.
Get the Slate Piece from there.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
首先，把它带给我。
沿着这条路往下走，
您会在港口附近遇到我的孙女。
从她那里拿到石板碎片。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The grudge against the people of
Bakonawa- I mean, the dead old lady.
The moon and this village...
She will try to destroy it.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
她对巴库暴龙——我是说，那位已故老妇人的怨恨。
月亮和这个村庄...
她会试图摧毁这一切。

scripts.text: Take vengeance? After all these years?
scripts.translation: 复仇？这么多年过去了？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
For some time, she has
blamed the moon and
resented the villagers.
The feeling grew larger as the time passed.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
有一段时间，她一直责怪月亮，
并怨恨村民们。
随着时间流逝，这种情绪越来越强烈。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Why do you think she became such a monster?
What do you think went through her head
for years and years?
Anger and vengeance.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
您觉得她为什么变成了这样的魔物？
您觉得她在漫长的岁月里，
脑海中在想什么？
愤怒和复仇。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Unforgettable grudge
that she was abandoned.
against the moon and the village.
This is why this grudge must be resolved.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
被抛弃的难忘怨恨，
针对月亮和村庄。
这就是为什么必须解决这份怨恨。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Please bring the ^FF0000Slate Piece^000000.
Down along this path
you will meet my granddaughter near the port.
Get the Slate Piece from there.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
请带来那块^FF0000石板碎片^000000。
沿着这条路往下走，
您会在港口附近遇到我的孙女。
从她那里拿到石板碎片。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Good, you have the Slate Piece.
Hold on to it and don't lose it.
It will be of helpful in tracking down the legend.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
很好，您有石板碎片了。
请保管好它，别弄丢了。
它在追踪传说时会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
I heard there is a man that lives by himself
at the end of northwestern part of Forest Field.
I heard someone saw a wooden doll there.
It is such a remote place that people like us
simply cannot travel there.
Could you visit the place for us?
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
我听说在普勒斯特西北部的尽头，
住着一个独居的男人。
我听说有人在那里看到了木制玩偶。
那个地方太偏僻了，
像我们这样的人根本无法前往。
您能替我们去那里看看吗？

scripts.text: Go there yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去！

scripts.text: Your explanation is too vague.
scripts.translation: 你的解释太模糊了。

scripts.text: On my way!
scripts.translation: 我出发了！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You twisted youth!
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
你这不知好歹的年轻人！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You have a point, but
this is the best I can do for now.
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
you will see a person.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
您说得对，
但目前我只能做到这个程度了。
那个地方在森林西北部的尽头。
过了桥再往西走，
您就会看到一个人。
祝您好运...为了我们...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You have a good heart young man!
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
You will see a ^0000FFMalaya Immigrant^000000.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
您是个心地善良的年轻人！
那个地方在森林西北部的尽头。
过了桥再往西走，
您就会看到一位^0000FF马拉雅移民^000000。
祝您好运...为了我们...

scripts.text: Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation: 祝您好运...为了我们...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
you will see a person.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
那个地方在森林西北部的尽头。
过了桥再往西走，
您就会看到一个人。
祝您好运...为了我们...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The track of the old lady's son
is connected all the way to
Baryo Mahiwaga?
There is a chance he wasn't a merchant...
I'm really curious about who he was...
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
老妇人的儿子的踪迹
竟然一直通到
巴里奥·马希瓦加？
看来他可能不是商人...
我真好奇他到底是谁...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Why did you come back here
instead of going straight to
Baryo Mahiwaga?
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
您为什么回到这里，
而不是直接去
巴里奥·马希瓦加？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Is that really true?
Bakonawa turning into an old lady
and fabricating the legend...
It seems all the villagers up until now
have been manipulated by that terrible monster.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
这是真的吗？
巴库暴龙变成老妇人
编造传说...
看来直到现在的村民们
都被那只可怕的魔物操控了。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is no reason to hesitate then.
You must go into Bakonawa's lair
before it attacks first.
I believe we can trust you to do this, yes?
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
既然如此，就没有犹豫的理由了。
您必须在它发动攻击之前
进入巴库暴龙的巢穴。
我相信您能完成这件事，对吗？

scripts.text: Well...
Of course!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The atmosphere was really good
but suddenly it's all ruined.
I didn't expect you to be so shy...
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
气氛本来很好，
结果一下子全毁了。
没想到您这么害羞...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
I will speak to
the village chief for you
so that you can enter the Bakonawa Lake.
Please get rid of this monster for us.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
我会替您向村长求情，
让您能进入食月暴龙湖。
请替我们除掉这只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
If you don't mind,
could you lend a hand to the Village Chief?
Nobody cares for each other anymore
because of Bakonawa...
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
如果您不介意，
能帮帮村长吗？
因为巴库暴龙，
大家都不再互相关心了...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The legend that
we believed for a hundred years,
all lies....
Please get rid of this monster for us.
scripts.translation:
[古老传说的讲述者]
我们信奉了百年的传说，
竟然全是谎言....
请替我们除掉这只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a brave heart
to come to such a remote place.
How is Port Malaya these days?
I heard the monster that lives at the lake, Baknoawa
is threatening the villagers.
I am in the dark about what is going on because I'm here all the time.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
您一定很有勇气，
才会来到这么偏僻的地方。
最近马来港怎么样了？
我听说住在湖里的魔物巴库暴龙
正在威胁村民们。
因为我一直待在这里，
对那里的情况一无所知。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a brave heart
to come to such a remote place.
How is Port Malaya these days?
I heard the monster that lives at the lake, Baknoawa
is threatening the villagers.
I am in the dark about what is going on because I'm here all the time.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
您一定很有勇气，
才会来到这么偏僻的地方。
最近马来港怎么样了？
我听说住在湖里的魔物巴库暴龙
正在威胁村民们。
因为我一直待在这里，
对那里的情况一无所知。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Are you the traveling merchant who used to sell Wooden Doll, right?
I don't know about any traveling merchant, but by Wooden Doll
(going through things) do you mean this?
I don't know about the specifics, but
I think it's related to what I heard long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
您就是那个以前卖木制玩偶的旅行商人，对吗？
我不认识什么旅行商人，但您说的木制玩偶
（翻找东西）是指这个吗？
我不太清楚具体细节，但
我觉得这和我很久以前听到的事有关。

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Do you know about this Slate Piece?
scripts.translation: 您知道这块石板涂鸦吗？

scripts.text: Please tell me the story.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我那个故事。

scripts.text: Who is the traveling merchant?
scripts.translation: 那个旅行商人是谁？

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I liked the environment here
so I decided to stay and live.
There is no obligation here.
To me, that's as good as heaven.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
我很喜欢这里的环境，
所以决定留下来生活。
这里没有束缚。
对我来说，这就如同天堂。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It is a very old Slate Piece.
I'm sorry but I never seen this before.
There is some kind of writing here
but I can't make it out.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
这是一块非常古老的石板涂鸦。
抱歉，我以前从未见过。
上面有一些文字，
但我认不出来。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It's a simple story.
^0000FFA wounded man who I had never seen before^000000
^0000FFcame to my house and asked for help.^000000
^0000FFOnce healed, he made a Wooden Doll^000000
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
故事很简单。
^0000FF一位我从未见过的受伤男子^000000
^0000FF来到我家寻求帮助。^000000
^0000FF痊愈后，他制作了一个木制玩偶^000000

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
^0000FFthat is suppose to chase away evil spirits ^000000
^0000FFas a token of gratitude,^000000
^0000FFand left for Baryo Mahiwaga.^000000
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
^0000FF据说那是用来驱赶邪恶精灵的^000000
^0000FF作为感谢的礼物，^000000
^0000FF然后他前往了Baryo Mahiwaga。^000000

scripts.text: He left for Baryo Mahiwaga?
scripts.translation: 他去了Baryo Mahiwaga？

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
According to what I've heard
that's correct. But the story has been
passed on from mouth to mouth for a
long time. I can't be sure.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
据我所知是这样的。但这个故事口耳相传了很久，
我无法确定其真实性。

scripts.text:
From Baryo Mahiwaga village, using keyword ^0000FFMalaya^000000,
or ^0000FFBakonawa^000000,
maybe I could find out the identity and whereabouts
of the traveling merchant.
scripts.translation:
从Baryo Mahiwaga村庄出发，使用关键词^0000FF马拉雅^000000，
或者^0000FF巴库暴龙^000000，
也许能查出那个旅行商人的身份和下落。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Well, there is a lack of information
so I can't make say for sure but
I'm skeptical if he was in fact even a merchant.
Coming to a town with a
critical wound seems too suspicious...
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
嗯，由于信息不足，我无法断定，
但我怀疑他是否真的是商人。
带着重伤来到城镇，这似乎太可疑了...

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
And craving a Wooden Doll
could be seen to have some kind of ritualistic meaning.
Protecting one from some evil force...
that kind of thing.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
而且执着于木制玩偶，
可能具有某种仪式意义。
保护某人免受邪恶力量侵害...
之类的事情。

scripts.text:
Identity of the traveling merchant...
Looks like there is one more
mystery to be solved.
I suppose it will all come to light
soon enough.
scripts.translation:
旅行商人的身份...
看来还有一个谜团待解。
我想很快真相就会大白了。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I will tell you again slowly
the story that has been passed on.
Listen carefully and repeat...
no, I mean, you don't have repeat it.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
我会再慢慢讲一遍那个口耳相传的故事。
请仔细听并复述...
不，我的意思是，你不需要复述。

scripts.text:
[Orally Transmitted Story]
^0000FFA wounded man who I had never seen before^000000
^0000FFcame to my house and asked for help.^000000
^0000FFOnce healed, as a token of gratitude, he made a Wooden Doll^000000
^0000FFthat is suppose to chase away evil sprits.^000000
^0000FFThen he left for Baryo Mahiwaga.^000000
scripts.translation:
[口耳相传的故事]
^0000FF一位我从未见过的受伤男子^000000
^0000FF来到我家寻求帮助。^000000
^0000FF痊愈后，作为感谢，他制作了一个木制玩偶^000000
^0000FF据说那是用来驱赶邪恶精灵的。^000000
^0000FF然后他前往了Baryo Mahiwaga。^000000

scripts.text:
From Baryo Mahiwaga village, using keyword ^0000FFMalaya^000000,
or ^0000FFBakonawa^000000,
maybe I could find out the identity and whereabouts
of the traveling merchant.
scripts.translation:
从Baryo Mahiwaga村庄出发，使用关键词^0000FF马拉雅^000000，
或者^0000FF巴库暴龙^000000，
也许能查出那个旅行商人的身份和下落。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Have you been to
Port Malaya?
I am curious to know
what is going on there
but I can't travel because there are monsters everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
你去过马来港吗？
我很好奇那里发生了什么，
但我无法前往，因为到处都是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Wooden Doll?
There is a tale related to that,
but you didn't come all the way
just to hear some folktale right?
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
木制玩偶？
有一个相关的传说，
但你不会大老远跑来只是为了听个民间故事吧？

scripts.text: I just came here to take a break.
scripts.translation: 我只是来这里休息一下。

scripts.text: Tell me the tale.
scripts.translation: 告诉我那个传说。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a lot of free time on your hands!
I'm no travel agent
so go bother someone else!
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
你肯定有很多空闲时间吧！
我又不是旅行社，
去找别人问吧！

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It's baloney
so I don't really remember the details.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
那是胡扯，
所以我也不记得具体细节了。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
to the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事梗概]
很久以前，5名剑士
与魔物巴库暴龙战斗。
四人战死，一人给魔物留下了致命伤，
但自己的腿也受了重伤。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事梗概]
逃离现场后，巴库暴龙变成了人类，
秘密追踪那名剑士。
剑士制作了一个木制玩偶，
可以阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
This is the end of story.
Without any conclusion...
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
故事到此结束。
没有结局...

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I heard there is a record that the swordsman left
but I don't understand why
he would leave it here in such a distant place
here instead of Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
我听说剑士留下了记录，
但我不明白他为什么
会把它留在这个遥远的地方，
而不是马拉雅。

scripts.text: I wish to see the record.
scripts.translation: 我想看看那份记录。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
The record is engraved on the stone ahead.
However, the stone is so badly
damaged and some pieces fell out that
it will be hard to make the words out.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
记录刻在前方那块石头上。
不过石头破损严重，
有些碎片脱落了，
很难辨认上面的文字。

scripts.text: Investigate the stone ahead.
scripts.translation: 调查前方的石头。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
The stone ahead holds a record that
a swordsman from a long time ago left.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
前方的石头上刻着
很久以前一名剑士留下的记录。

scripts.text: Where did this swordsman go after?
scripts.translation: 这名剑士后来去了哪里？

scripts.text: Tell me the tale again.
scripts.translation: 再给我讲讲这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Well, there is no story after that so
I guess nobody would know what happened.
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
嗯，之后就没有故事了，
所以我想没人知道后来发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
on the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事梗概]
很久以前，5名剑士
与魔物巴库暴龙战斗。
四人战死，一人给魔物留下了致命伤，
但自己的腿也受了重伤。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事梗概]
逃离现场后，巴库暴龙变成了人类，
秘密追踪那名剑士。
剑士制作了一个木制玩偶，
可以阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I suppose you wish to hear the story again right?
No problem! I can tell this story forever!
scripts.translation:
[马拉雅移民]
我想你是想再听一遍这个故事吧？
没问题！这个故事我可以讲上一辈子！

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
on the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事梗概]
很久以前，5名剑士
与魔物巴库暴龙战斗。
四人战死，一人给魔物留下了致命伤，
但自己的腿也受了重伤。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民间故事梗概]
逃离现场后，巴库暴龙变成了人类，
秘密追踪那名剑士。
剑士制作了一个木制玩偶，
可以阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
The damage is so severe
that the record is unidentifiable.
When inserting the Slate Piece
to a hole on the wall, it fits perfectly like a piece of puzzle.
The letters are not clear but you can still read it.
scripts.translation:
损坏得太严重了，
记录无法辨认。
将石板碎片
嵌入墙上的孔洞时，
它像拼图一样完美契合。
字迹虽然模糊，
但依然可以阅读。

scripts.text:
Here is the record left by a swordsman
from a hundred years ago.
scripts.translation: 这是百年前一名剑士留下的记录。

scripts.text: I don't need to read it.
scripts.translation: 我不需要阅读它。

scripts.text: Read the record again.
scripts.translation: 再读一遍记录。

scripts.text:
I remember the story clearly.
Let's tell the ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000 in Malaya
about what I discovered.
scripts.translation:
我清楚地记得这个故事。
让我去马拉雅告诉^0000FF古老传说的讲述者^000000
我的发现。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
After fighting with Bakonawa, I sustained a critical wound
and came to this place.
Only thing I can do is
Place the Wooden Doll in one place
the monster would come.
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
在与巴库暴龙战斗后，我受了致命伤，
来到了这里。
我能做的只有
将木制玩偶放在
魔物会来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
^0000FFSometimes transforming into a child, or even a old lady,^000000
I know that ^0000FFBakonawa^000000has been
chasing after me in secret to kill me.
Because of that critical injury the monster * sustained,
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
^0000FF有时它变成孩子，甚至老妇人，^000000
我知道^0000FF巴库暴龙^000000一直在
暗中追踪我，想要杀我。
因为那道致命伤，

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
** it will need nearly a hundred years
for Bakonawa to absorb the power of the moon
to fully recover its power.
Beware of the day the moon disappears.
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
**巴库暴龙需要将近一百年
吸收月亮的力量
才能完全恢复实力。
当心月亮消失的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
The day will come when Bakonawa
will run amuck.
But it will take nearly a hundred years to fully recover its power.
There will always be someone better than me
to defeat the vile creature.
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
巴库暴龙肆虐的日子终将到来。
但它需要将近一百年才能完全恢复实力。
总会有比我更优秀的人
击败这邪恶的生物。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
I will place my trust in the one that will replace me ages from now...
scripts.translation:
[百年前剑士留下的记录]
我将把希望寄托在
未来接替我的那个人身上...

scripts.text:
How could this be...
Lie told by Bakonawa when it turned into an old lady
in order to take revenge on the swordsman
turned into a legend after all these years.
scripts.translation:
怎么会这样...
巴库暴龙变成老妇人时编造的谎言，
为了向剑士复仇，
竟然在这么多年后变成了传说。

scripts.text:
I found out that Bakonawa
is nothing but a blood thirsty monster.
I must tell what I know to the ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000
in Malaya.
scripts.translation:
我发现巴库暴龙
不过是一个嗜血的魔物。
我必须去马拉雅告诉^0000FF古老传说的讲述者^000000
我所知道的一切。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Grandpa believes
Bakonawa can
turn good.
Do you think it's possible?
scripts.translation:
[老人的孙女]
爷爷相信
巴库暴龙是可以变好的。
你觉得有可能吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
^FF0000Slate Piece^000000?
Why would you need something
that is barely recognizable?
I'll give it to you if you want.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孙女]
^FF0000石板碎片^000000？
为什么你需要一个
几乎无法辨认的东西？
如果你想要的话，我就给你。

scripts.text:
Let's go to the
^FF0000Old Legend Teller^000000
now that I have the Slate Piece.
scripts.translation:
既然我有了石板碎片，
现在就去见^FF0000古老传说的讲述者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Please take this Slate Piece
and deliver it to my grandpa.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孙女]
请收下这块石板碎片，
并把它交给我的爷爷。

scripts.text:
Let's go to the
^FF0000Old Legend Teller^000000
now that I have the Slate Piece.
scripts.translation:
既然我有了石板碎片，
现在就去见^FF0000古老传说的讲述者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Because of Bakonawa,
the village is always unpeaceful.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孙女]
因为巴库暴龙，
村庄总是不得安宁。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Angry Man]
Calm Bakonawa?
Do you know how many people have been
sacrificed by Bakonawa?
I will fight on my own if I have to!
scripts.translation:
[愤怒的男子]
安抚巴库暴龙？
你知道有多少人
被巴库暴龙杀害了吗？
如果有必要，我会独自战斗！

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Calm Little Girl]
It is too dangerous to fight against
Bakonawa. There is a chance
it will get more angry and put children and
elders in danger.
scripts.translation:
[冷静的小女孩]
与巴库暴龙战斗太危险了。
它可能会变得更加愤怒，
从而危及孩子和老人的安全。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Angry Boy]
I lost my father and my friend
to that Bakonawa.
I will surely revenge them!
scripts.translation:
[愤怒的男孩]
我的父亲和朋友
都死在那只巴库暴龙手里。
我一定要为他们报仇！

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 无法开始对话。你携带的物品太多了。-

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I'm desperate for a helping hand
but you look
too weak and fragile.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我急需帮手，
但你看起来
太弱小、太脆弱了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Please come back when
you grow strong enough
to match Incubus.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
等你变得足够强大，
能够匹敌恶魔侍者时，
再回来吧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I'm don't know what's the right decision.
To fight against Bakonawa,
or calm it by offering it a sacrificial gift.
Recently, there have been more people that have
been harmed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我不知道什么才是正确的决定。
是去对抗巴库暴龙，
还是献上祭品来安抚它。
最近，被巴库暴龙伤害的人越来越多了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The legend was all a lie?
It seems all the villagers up until now
were manipulated by that vile monster.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
传说竟然全是谎言？
看来一直以来，
村民们都被那只邪恶的魔物操控了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Recently, there have been more people that have
been harmed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
最近，被巴库暴龙伤害的人越来越多了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
There are some missing villagers
but I can't find out if
they are simply missing or if they have been
killed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
有一些村民失踪了，
但我无法确定
他们只是失踪了，
还是已经被巴库暴龙杀害了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I heard that the belongings of the missing people
are being found at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
Please go there to find ^0000FFLost Belongings^000000
and give them to the families of
the missing people
in whatever amount they want.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我听说失踪者的物品
出现在巴里奥·马希瓦加平原。
请去那里寻找^0000FF丢失的物品^000000，
并将它们交给失踪者的家人，
数量由他们决定。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
^0000FFLost Belongings^000000
are said to be carried by
^FF0000Tiyanak^000000 that roams Baryo Mahiwaga.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
据说^0000FF丢失的物品^000000
是被在巴里奥·马希瓦加游荡的
^FF0000恶魔婴儿^000000携带的。

scripts.text: Do it yourself.
scripts.translation: 我自己去做

scripts.text: I'm on my way.
scripts.translation: 我这就去

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
You give me a lot to think about.
Leave the village at once.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
你让我有很多事要思考。
立刻离开村庄。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Let's start then. First,
retrieve two ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and take them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Father^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
那就开始吧。首先，
从恶魔婴儿那里夺回两件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000，
并替我交给^0000FF失踪者的父亲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
From Tiyanak that roams Baryo Mahiwaga Field,
retrieve two ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Father^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
从游荡在巴里奥·马希瓦加草原的恶魔婴儿那里，
夺回两件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000，
并替我交给^0000FF失踪者的父亲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve Seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
从恶魔婴儿那里夺回七件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000，
并替我交给^0000FF失踪者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Son^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
从恶魔婴儿那里夺回三件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000，
并替我交给^0000FF失踪者的儿子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Mother^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
从恶魔婴儿那里夺回五件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000，
并替我交给^0000FF失踪者的母亲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
So it's clear that all the missing people
have been killed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
看来所有失踪者
都被巴库暴龙杀害了。

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
Kill Bakonawa!
Let's get rid of the monster ourselves!
scripts.translation:
[村民们]
杀死巴库暴龙！
我们要亲手消灭这只魔物！

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
It seems we would no longer be able to
hold rituals to calm Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
看来我们再也无法
举行安抚巴库暴龙的仪式了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Young Fortune Teller is looking for your help
saying that the energy of the moon seems strange.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
年轻的占卜师正在寻求帮助，
她说月亮的能量似乎有些异常。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Young Fortune Teller is looking for your help
saying that the energy of the moon seems strange.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
年轻的占卜师正在寻求帮助，
她说月亮的能量似乎有些异常。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I know that terrible things happened
long time ago when the moon disappeared.
I hope the moon recovers its strength
with your devoted effort.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我知道很久以前月亮消失时，
发生过可怕的事情。
希望凭借你的努力，
月亮能恢复它的光芒。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I will tell the
Young Fortune Teller to help you.
But before that, there is
something you must do immediately.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我会让年轻的占卜师来帮助你。
但在那之前，
有一件事你必须立刻去做。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
We never know when Bakonawa will attack
the village so we must set traps near the village
entrance and near the cave.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我们不知道巴库暴龙何时会袭击村庄，
所以必须在村口和洞穴附近设置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I would be grateful if you help us.
I have dispatched workers
near where traps will be set up,
so you just have to visit about 5 places.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
如果你能帮上忙，我将不胜感激。
我已经派工人在设置陷阱的地点附近等候，
你只需要去大约5个地方即可。

scripts.text: Sounds like too much work.
scripts.translation: 听起来工作量太大了

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
This operation means life and death to us
yet you refuse it easily as if
it was some kind of a chore...
scripts.translation:
[村长]
这项行动关乎我们的生死存亡，
你却像对待杂务一样轻易拒绝...

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
What a hero!
scripts.translation:
[村长]
真是位英雄！

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The first trap will be set up at
Baryo Mahiwaga Field
near the village entrance. ^0000FFGruffy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第一个陷阱将设置在巴里奥·马希瓦加草原，
靠近村口的地方。^0000FF粗声粗气的工人^000000
会在那里等你。他会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The first trap will be set up at
Baryo Mahiwaga Field
near the village entrance. ^0000FFGruffy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第一个陷阱将设置在巴里奥·马希瓦加草原，
靠近村口的地方。^0000FF粗声粗气的工人^000000
会在那里等你。他会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The second trap will be set up
near a place where it connects from
Baryo Mahiwaga Field to Bakonawa Lake.
^0000FFGrumpy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第二个陷阱将设置在巴里奥·马希瓦加草原
通往食月暴龙湖的交界处附近。
^0000FF脾气暴躁的工人^000000
会在那里等你。他会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The third trap will be set up
near Bakonawa Lake Entrance.
^0000FFCowardly Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第三个陷阱将设置在食月暴龙湖入口附近。
^0000FF胆小的工人^000000
会在那里等你。他会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The fourth trap will be set up
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake as well.
^0000FFGloomy Worker^000000 will be waiting for you.
He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第四个陷阱也将设置在食月暴龙湖入口附近。
^0000FF阴郁的工人^000000会在那里等你。
他会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The fifth trap will be set up
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake too.
^0000FFSentimental Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
第五个陷阱也将设置在食月暴龙湖入口附近。
^0000FF多愁善感的工人^000000
会在那里等你。他会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
It looks like the traps are all set up.
We just finished our village meeting on
what to do about Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
看起来陷阱都已经布置好了。
我们刚刚结束了关于如何应对巴库暴龙的村民会议。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
We have concluded that
we will fight against Bakonawa.
Please help us by
attacking his lair.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
我们决定要对抗巴库暴龙。
请协助我们，去攻击它的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Would you visit ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000
when you have a chance?
I think you would be able to help him.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
如果您有空的话，
请去拜访一下^0000FF古老传说的讲述者^000000。
我想您应该能帮到他。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Please think of the countless victims
and defeat Bakonawa
for their sake.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
请为了那些无数的受害者，
击败巴库暴龙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Thank you.
Please think of the countless victims
and defeat Bakonawa
for their sake.
scripts.translation:
[村长]
谢谢您。
请为了那些无数的受害者，
击败巴库暴龙。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
Please find our
child.
Bakonawa would have not harmed our child.
He must be around here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
请找到我们的孩子。
巴库暴龙不会伤害我们的孩子。
他一定就在附近某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
You are looking for two of his ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000?
Are you confident that
he already died?
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
您是在寻找他的两件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000吗？
您确信他已经死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
This... is our child's ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
for sure.
The monster got to him after all....
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
这...这肯定是我家孩子的^FF0000丢失的物品^000000。
终究还是被魔物给袭击了...

scripts.text:
The man is unable to continue as he tries to hold back his tears.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Let's retrieve them from Tiyanak that roams Baryo Mahiwaga Field,
seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子试图忍住泪水，却无法继续说下去。
让我们继续寻找失踪者的丢失物品。
从徘徊在巴里奥·马希瓦加草原的恶魔婴儿身上，
收集七件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000，
并交给^0000FF失踪者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
My baby... my poor baby...
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
我的孩子...我可怜的孩子...

scripts.text:
The man is unable to continue as he tries to hold back his tears.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子试图忍住泪水，却无法继续说下去。
让我们继续寻找失踪者的丢失物品。
从恶魔婴儿身上收集七件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000，
并交给^0000FF失踪者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
My baby... my poor baby...
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的父亲]
我的孩子...我可怜的孩子...

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
Please find
my friend.
We were playing ball together
and suddenly my friend disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
请找到我的朋友。
我们本来在一起玩球，
突然之间我的朋友就消失了。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
I'm sure he is alive and well
somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
我相信他一定还活着，
就在某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
You are looking for seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my friend?
My friend is not dead!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
您是在寻找我朋友的七件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000吗？
我的朋友没有死！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
These are marbles and toys I gave him...
These are clearly ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my friend... Where is my friend?
Bring him here, bring him here now!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
这些是我给他的弹珠和玩具...
这些明显是我朋友的^FF0000丢失的物品^000000...我的朋友在哪里？
把他带回来，现在就把他带回来！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
Bring back my friend!
Bring back my friend now!
My friend is alive,
It's all a lie, sob~
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的朋友]
把我的朋友带回来！
现在就把他带回来！
我的朋友还活着，
这都是谎言，呜呜~

scripts.text:
Leaving behind the crying boy,
let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Son^000000.
scripts.translation:
留下哭泣的男孩，
让我们继续寻找失踪者的丢失物品。
从恶魔婴儿身上收集三件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000，
并交给^0000FF失踪者的儿子^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
Bakonawa has hurt my father?
I can't believe this.
Please find my father!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的儿子]
巴库暴龙伤害了我的父亲？
我无法相信这件事。
请找到我的父亲！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
You are looking for three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my father? Why lost belongings and not my father?
No, that can't be it. He is alive somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的儿子]
您是在寻找我父亲的三件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000吗？为什么是丢失的物品，而不是我父亲？
不，不可能。他一定还活着，在某个地方！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
These are clearly his clothes and shoes...
These are ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my father.
Oh dear lord... father!
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的儿子]
这些明显是他的衣服和长靴...
这些是我父亲的^FF0000丢失的物品^000000。
天哪...父亲！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
Why did such a thing happen....
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的儿子]
为什么...会发生这种事...

scripts.text:
Man crying in agony.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Mother^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子悲痛欲绝。
让我们继续寻找失踪者的丢失物品。
从恶魔婴儿身上收集五件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000，
并交给^0000FF失踪者的母亲^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
Please find my child.
I sent her out to do a chore
and she still isn't back.
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
请帮我找到我的孩子。
我让她出门做点家务，
但她到现在还没回来。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
You are looking for five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my child?
What does this mean?
Are you saying my child is dead?
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
你是在寻找我孩子的五件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000吗？
这是什么意思？
你是说我孩子已经死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
This is my child's hair comb.
Why do you have five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my child?
Why...? She's... dead?
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
这是我孩子的发梳。
为什么你会有我孩子的五件^FF0000丢失的物品^000000？
为什么...？她...死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
No wait... I think I hear her voice.
She's going to be home soon. I should go home now.
I should prepare a dinner for her. She must be starving.
Ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
不，等等...我好像听到了她的声音。
她马上就要回家了。我该回家了。
我应该为她准备晚餐。她一定饿坏了。
哈哈...

scripts.text:
A mother that has gone mad...
Now that I finished finding the missing people,
I should report back to the Village Chief.
scripts.translation:
一位已经疯掉母亲...
既然我已经找到了失踪者，
我应该向村长汇报。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
Ha ha ha... I can hear my child's voice,
just listen closely.
Can't you hear her calling her mother?
Ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[失踪者的母亲]
哈哈哈...我能听到我孩子的声音，
请仔细听。
你难道听不到她在呼唤母亲吗？
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
A mother that has gone mad...

scripts.translation:
一位已经疯掉母亲...

scripts.text: A mother that has gone mad...
scripts.translation: 一位已经疯掉母亲...

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 无法开始对话。你携带的物品太多了。-

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎对你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
The energy of the moon grew weak.
The reason there are more monsters,
and the reason there are more victims,
is all because of this.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的占卜师]
月亮的能量变弱了。
魔物变多，
受害者变多，
这都是因为月亮能量减弱。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
The energy of the moon grew weak for a couple of days.
The reason there are more monsters,
and the reason there are more victims, is all because of this.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的占卜师]
月亮的能量已经减弱了好几天了。
魔物变多，
受害者变多，
这都是因为月亮能量减弱。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I'm trying to hold a ritual
that will restore the moon's energy by sacrificing monsters' blood,
so I need you to hunt fifteen ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的占卜师]
我正在举行一个仪式，
通过献祭魔物的血液来恢复月亮的能量，
所以你需要在巴里奥·马希瓦加平原猎杀十五只^FF0000邪魔马^000000。

scripts.text: It's none of my business.
scripts.translation: 这不关我的事。

scripts.text: You can count on me.
scripts.translation: 包在我身上。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
You are so selfish!
During the ritual,
I will pray for your bad luck too.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的占卜师]
你太自私了！
在仪式期间，
我也会为你祈祷，让你摆脱厄运。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
Hurry.
If the moon completely disappears,
there will be a great disaster.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的占卜师]
快一点。
如果月亮完全消失，
将会发生大灾难。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
It looks like you took care of ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
well enough.
I think I can start the ritual now.
There are some items that we need, please go to
the Village Chief for help.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的占卜师]
看来你已经很好地处理了^FF0000邪魔马^000000。
我想现在可以开始仪式了。
我们需要一些物品，请去村长那里寻求帮助。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I need you to hunt fifteen ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的占卜师]
你需要在巴里奥·马希瓦加平原猎杀十五只^FF0000邪魔马^000000。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
Hurry.
If the moon completely disappears,
there will be a great disaster.
scripts.translation:

快一点。
如果月亮完全消失，

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]

the Village Chief for help.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的占卜师]
我想现在可以开始仪式了。
我们需要一些物品，请去村长那里寻求帮助。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
On the day when the moon fully disappears,
the dragon will attack the village.
No one will be safe.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的占卜师]
在月亮完全消失的那一天，
龙会袭击村庄。
没有人能幸免。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
The Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
scripts.translation:
[粗声粗气的工人]
村长让我在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
The trap will be set right in front.
Walk forward a little.
scripts.translation:
[粗声粗气的工人]
陷阱就设在前面。
往前走一点。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go and set up the trap together.
scripts.translation:
[粗声粗气的工人]
脾气暴躁的工人在巴里奥·马希瓦加平原与食月暴龙湖的交界处附近。
去那里和他一起布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
Are you trying to advertise that
there is a trap here? Step aside.
scripts.translation:
[粗声粗气的工人]
你是在这里打广告说这里有陷阱吗？让开。

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我应该就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
Using the tools like this
bang bang bang!
scripts.translation:
[粗声粗气的工人]
像这样使用工具
叮叮当当！

scripts.text: bang bang bang!
scripts.translation: 叮叮当当！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已经布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go and set up the trap together.
scripts.translation:
[粗声粗气的工人]
脾气暴躁的工人在巴里奥·马希瓦加平原与食月暴龙湖的交界处附近。
去那里和他一起布置陷阱。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已经在这里布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
This trap is not meant to capture you,
so move.
scripts.translation:
[粗声粗气的工人]
这个陷阱不是用来抓你的，
快让开。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go there to him.
scripts.translation:
[粗声粗气的工人]
脾气暴躁的工人在巴里奥·马希瓦加平原与食月暴龙湖的交界处附近。
去那里找他。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
Sooo boring!
scripts.translation:
[脾气暴躁的工人]
村长让我在这里等你。
好...无聊啊！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
A hole needs to be dug up in front of here?
I have to dig too?
Says who?
scripts.translation:
[脾气暴躁的工人]
要在前面挖个洞？
我也得挖？
谁说的？

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[脾气暴躁的工人]
去食月暴龙湖入口附近找胆小的工人。
快点，动起来！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
I set up the trap
and you are advertising that it's here.
Scram!
scripts.translation:
[脾气暴躁的工人]
我布置了陷阱，
你却在这里打广告说这里有陷阱。
滚开！

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我应该就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
I really don't like it here!
...
With this pickax,
dig dig dig!
scripts.translation:
[脾气暴躁的工人]
我真的很讨厌这里！
...
用这个镐子，
挖挖挖！

scripts.text: dig dig dig!
scripts.translation: 挖挖挖！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已经布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[脾气暴躁的工人]
去食月暴龙湖入口附近找胆小的工人。
快点，动起来！

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已经在这里布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Are you trying to test
with your body if the trap works?
Move aside!
scripts.translation:
[脾气暴躁的工人]
你是在用身体测试陷阱是否有效吗？
让开！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[脾气暴躁的工人]
去食月暴龙湖入口附近找胆小的工人。
快点，动起来！

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
Why me? I have a bad feeling about this....
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
村长让我在这里等你。
为什么是我？我对这件事有种不好的预感....

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
set up a trap in front of here?
Village Chief said I have to help too?
Can you please do it by yourself?
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
要在前面布置陷阱？
村长说我也得帮忙？
你能不能自己搞定？

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
Go! You scare me.
You look like you are going to beat me up.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
往上走就能找到阴郁的工人。
快去吧！你吓到我了。
你看起来像是要揍我一样。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go away!
What if Bakonawa
appears because of you?
I'm scared to death!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
快走开！
万一因为你引来了巴库暴龙怎么办？
我吓死了！

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我应该就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
There is nothing weird
buried here right?
...
Using the shovel, dig dig dig!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
这里没有埋什么奇怪的东西吧？
...
用铲子，挖挖挖！

scripts.text: dig dig dig!
scripts.translation: 挖挖挖！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已经布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
往上走就能找到阴郁的工人。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已经在这里布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Step aside immediately!
Bakonawa might find out this is a trap
and come for us.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
马上让开！
巴库暴龙可能会发现这是个陷阱，然后冲过来找我们。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的工人]
往上走就能找到阴郁的工人。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Village Chief told me to wait for you here.
He must want me to do something.
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的工人]
村长让我在这里等你。
他肯定是有什么事要我做。
呼...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
set up a trap on the left side?
I don't think it will be much use...
Whew, I should've moved away or something...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的工人]
要在左边布置陷阱？
我觉得这没什么用...
呼，我早该搬走才对...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
We are all gonna die anyway by Bakonawa.
This is pointless.
Just go up the path and you will find
Sentimental Worker.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的工人]
反正最后都会被巴库暴龙杀死。
做这些毫无意义。
沿着路往上走就能找到多愁善感的工人。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Bakonawa is going to attack us anyway.
What pointless work...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的工人]
反正巴库暴龙都会攻击我们。
真是白费力气...

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我应该就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Just catch this net,
throw throw!
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的工人]
拿着这张网，
扔扔扔！

scripts.text: throw throw!
scripts.translation: 扔扔扔！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已经布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Just go up the path and you will find
Sentimental Worker.
Though I doubt it will be much help.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的工人]
沿着路往上走就能找到多愁善感的工人。
不过我觉得他也没什么帮助。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已经在这里布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
The trap is meaningless.
See? It doesn't even work.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的工人]
这陷阱毫无意义。
看吧，它甚至不起作用。

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Village Chief told me to wait for you here.
Is there a some kind of surprise event?
My heart is beating faster~
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
村长让我在这里等你。
是不是有什么惊喜活动？
我的心跳得好快~

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Wow! So we are going to work together
to set up a trap behind this place?
This is sooo cool!
This is the coolest thing in the world!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
哇！我们要一起在这里后面布置陷阱吗？
这也太酷了！
这是世界上最酷的事情！

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Now that the trap is set,
Are we going to report back to Village Chief?
Oh what fun!
It sounds so exiting!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
陷阱布置好了，
我们要去回报村长吗？
太有趣了！
听起来好激动人心！

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
More I think about it, more exited I get.
I'm secretly guarding the trap!
I want to hear out loud.
I have a trap in front of me! Ha ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
越想越激动。
我正在秘密守护着陷阱！
我想大声说出来。
我面前有一个陷阱！哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我应该就在这里布置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Wow! This really is a perfect place
to set up a trap.
I'm going to throw the rope!
Here goes the rope!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
哇！这里真的是布置陷阱的完美地点。
我要扔绳子了！
绳子飞出去！

scripts.text: Here goes the rope!
scripts.translation: 绳子飞出去！

scripts.text:
The trap is now set.
Let's go to the Village Chief
now that the trap is set.
scripts.translation:
陷阱已经布置好了。
既然陷阱设好了，
我们去见村长吧。

scripts.text: The trap is set here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱在这里布置好了。

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Try out the trap first!
I'm so curious
what would happen!
It's going to be so much fun!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
先试试陷阱吧！
我很好奇
会发生什么！
一定很有趣！

scripts.text: Seafood and Black Bean Sauce Noodle!
scripts.translation: 海鲜黑豆酱面！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Just boldly tell me
what is it that you want!
scripts.translation:
[布里凯计划]
大胆地告诉我，
你想要什么！

scripts.text: Reset all quests
scripts.translation: 重置所有任务

scripts.text: Just before the end of first quest
scripts.translation: 第一个任务结束前

scripts.text: Reset secondary quest
scripts.translation: 重置次要任务

scripts.text: Distribution of lost belongings
scripts.translation: 分发丢失的物品

scripts.text: Just after hunting
scripts.translation: 狩猎结束后

scripts.text: Here you go!
scripts.translation: 给你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[布里凯计划]
给你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!

[布里凯计划]
给你！

[布里凯计划]
给你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[布里凯计划]
给你！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A talisman?
I think you should search for something else.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
护身符？
我觉得你应该找找别的东西。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A talisman and a person?
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
护身符和一个人？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I did see the talisman but I didn't go near it because I got a bad feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
我确实看到了那个护身符，但我没有靠近，因为我对它有种不好的预感。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
Speaking of talismans, wouldn't that old lady know about them, since she put some around the village?
I think it'll be a good idea to ask her.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
哦！
说到护身符，那位老妇人应该很了解，因为她把一些护身符挂在了村庄周围。
我觉得去问问她是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
Speaking of talismans, wouldn't that old lady know about them, since she put some around the hospital?
I think it'll be a good idea to ask her.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
哦！
说到护身符，那位老妇人应该很了解，因为她把一些护身符挂在了医院周围。
我觉得去问问她是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A shaman... Best if we met her.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
萨满...最好能去见见她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
You must have met her.
I feel something strong...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
哦！
你一定已经见过她了。
我感觉到一股强烈的力量...

scripts.text: Tell her about the talisman.
scripts.translation: 告诉她关于护身符的事

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Yes!
I have an idea.
How about we stick that one over the one we saw on the 2nd floor door?
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
是的！
我有个主意。
我们要不要把它贴在我们之前在二楼门上看到的那个上面？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Maybe it will block the bad energy it's giving out.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
也许这样能阻挡它散发出的邪恶能量。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Yes!
I have an idea.
How about we stick that one over the one we saw on the 2nd floor door?
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
是的！
我有个主意。
我们要不要把它贴在我们之前在二楼门上看到的那个上面？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Maybe it will block the bad energy it's giving out.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
也许这样能阻挡它散发出的邪恶能量。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
*Sigh*...
I thought it strange when you were standing behind me....
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
*叹气*...
刚才你站在我身后的时候，我就觉得有点奇怪....

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
I didn't think you'd do something like this.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
没想到你会做出这种事。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
We were just about to enter Bangungot's room, before we were thrown out...
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
我们本来正要进入噩梦死神般滚勾特的房间，结果却被赶了出来...

scripts.text: Bangungot?
scripts.translation: 噩梦死神般滚勾特？

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne?
scripts.translation: 护士 梅恩？

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne
scripts.translation: 护士 梅恩

scripts.text: Bangungot
scripts.translation: 噩梦死神般滚勾特

scripts.text: Enter the hospital.
scripts.translation: 进入医院

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
嗯...

scripts.text:

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Tsk...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
啧...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It's a vicious monster roaming this hospital.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
那是一只在这家医院游荡的凶恶魔物。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Hmmmm...
It's not exactly a monster....
More like a curse or disease...
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
嗯...
它其实不完全是魔物...
更像是一种诅咒或疾病...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
There's a story saying that it used to be a wood fairy.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
传说它曾经是一个森林妖精。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Anyway, it doesnt change the fact that she killed the patients of this hospital and turned them into monsters.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
总之，这并不改变她杀害了这家医院的病人并将他们变成魔物这一事实。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Me?
As you can see, I'm the new nurse here.
I'm a nurse who specializes in 'this' kind of work, instead of looking after patients.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
我吗？
如您所见，我是这里的新护士。
我专门负责处理“这类”工作，而不是照顾病人。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Oh!
The Bangungot pretended to be me?
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
哦！
噩梦死神般滚勾特伪装成了我？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Seeing how much it rattled you.
It's a rather smart one.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
看它把你吓得够呛的样子。
它还挺聪明的。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Simply said, I cure unnatural phenomenon around hospitals.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
简单来说，我负责治疗医院周围的异常现象。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Many things happen in the world.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
这个世界上会发生很多事情。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
She may have rooted here deeper than I thought.
I can still feel her presence.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
她在这里扎根比我想象的更深。
我依然能感觉到她的存在。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
What you killed was a part of her...
But, it was a big help since you confused and damaged her at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
你杀死的只是她的一部分...
不过，这帮了大忙，因为你同时扰乱并伤害了她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It makes things a lot easier.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
这让事情变得容易多了。
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It would've been easier if she was apart from her body, but now that she returned to her room, this is going to be a little tricky.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
如果她不在身体里，事情会更容易些，但现在她回到了房间，这就有点棘手了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Of course, don't you dare walk away from this, since you disturbed my job and led her to her room.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
当然，你绝对不可以就这样走开，毕竟是你打扰了我的工作，还把她引到了房间。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
If you make it to the 2nd floor door, I'll open a small door to her room for you.
After that, she's all yours.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
如果你能到达二楼的门口，我会为你打开通往她房间的小门。
之后，就交给你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
People of this town are too cautious of outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
这个城镇的人对外来者太警惕了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I'm sure they have their reasons, but I wish they'd tell me how to get closer...
scripts.translation:
[护士]
我相信他们有自己的理由，但我希望他们能告诉我如何拉近关系...

scripts.text:
There's a nurse outside the hospital holding a large bag.
I don't think I can help her.
scripts.translation:
医院外站着一位护士，手里提着一个大袋子。
我觉得我帮不了她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Hey, hold on.
Are you planning on going inside?
scripts.translation:
[护士]
嘿，等一下。
你打算进去吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Oh~
I'm so glad!
I was literally waiting all day for someone to some by.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
哦~
太好了！
我简直等了一整天，终于有人来了。

scripts.text: About the hospital
scripts.translation: 关于医院

scripts.text: Reason for stalling me
scripts.translation: 拦我的原因

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
This hospital is the only one in town.
And it's going to be my new job.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
这家医院是镇上唯一的医院。
而且，这里将成为我的新工作场所。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I heard it was just built, but it seems so creepy....
scripts.translation:
[护士]
听说它是刚建好的，但看起来好诡异....

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I was surprised when I got here too.
It says 'closed' all around it!
scripts.translation:
[护士]
我来的时候也很惊讶。
周围都贴着“停业”！

scripts.text: Reason for stalling me.
scripts.translation: 拦我的原因

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I was told that they needed nurses in this town,
so I came here after turning down numerous proposals.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
听说这个城镇需要护士，
所以我拒绝了无数其他提议，来到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I'd heard they were really cautious of outsiders...
scripts.translation:
[护士]
我听说他们对外来者非常警惕...

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Not even a soul to welcome me, let alone a party!
Shocking!
scripts.translation:
[护士]
连一个欢迎我的人都没有，更别提举办欢迎会了！
太令人震惊了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
What's more, I made it here after being lost and now I'm facing a creepy and locked hospital!
scripts.translation:
[护士]
更糟糕的是，我迷路才好不容易来到这里，结果面对的却是一座阴森森的、上了锁的医院！

算了。

scripts.text:

Oh, I see...
scripts.translation:
[护士]
哦，我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Now that you say it... If you're going inside, could you take me with you?
scripts.translation:
[护士]
您这么一说...如果您要进去的话，能带上我吗？

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Doors are locked!
My bags are heavy!
And my legs are killing me.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
门都锁着！
我的行李好重！
而且我的腿快断了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
If I knew this was going to happen, I would've worn ER night-shift shoes instead of first-day shoes... *sniff*
scripts.translation:
[护士]
如果早知道会这样，我当初就该穿急诊夜班的长靴，而不是第一天上班穿的鞋...*吸鼻子*

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙

scripts.text: Don't help.
scripts.translation: 不帮忙

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
*Sob*
I guess this world is still worth living in.
You are too kind.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
*抽泣*
看来这个世界还是值得活下去的。
您真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I'm 'Las', who's supposed to work in this hospital.
By the looks of it, though, I may become jobless...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
我是“拉斯”，本该在这家医院工作。
不过看这情况，我可能要失业了...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Let's start by getting inside.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
首先，我们得想办法进去。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Before that....
Could you get something to wrap my feet? I can't put my shoes on because I've got blisters.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
在那之前...
能帮我找点东西裹一下脚吗？我脚上磨出了水泡，穿不了鞋。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
2 Rotten Bandages should do to wrap both my feet. They may look dirty, but they have special liquid on them that have amazing effects.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
两条腐烂绷带应该就够裹住双脚了。虽然看起来很脏，但上面涂有特殊液体，效果惊人。

I know they're effective but... Not so tempting.
scripts.translation:

哦......
我知道它们很有效，但是...看起来不太诱人。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Rotten Bandages... A fit name for something that seems to have been cut fresh from a mummy.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
腐烂绷带...这名字真贴切，看起来就像刚从木乃伊身上撕下来的。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I'm having second thoughts looking at them, but as I am to be a professional nurse!!
Here goes nothing!!!
Ewwww!!
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
看着它们我有点犹豫，但我可是专业的护士！！
豁出去了！！！
呕！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
*Squish*
*Squelch*
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
*噗叽*
*咕叽*

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Ahhhhh...
My feet feel a lot better now, but it smells funny.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
啊......
脚感觉好多了，但是味道有点怪。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh...... the smell......
My new shoes will be ruined...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
哦......这味道......
我的新鞋要遭殃了...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Okay!!!!!!
I don't know if it's locked or stuck, let's try pushing it together!
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
好！！！！
不知道是锁住了还是卡住了，我们一起推吧！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Okay!!!!!!
I don't know if it's locked or stuck, let's try pushing it together!
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
好！！！！
不知道是锁住了还是卡住了，我们一起推吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We pushed and pulled, but it won't budge.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们推也推不动，拉也拉不开。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Strange~
They wouldn't have sent me to a closed down hospital.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
奇怪~
总部不会派我来一家已经关闭的医院。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hmmm!
I can't stand it anymore!
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
哼！
我受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Could you ask the townsfolk about the hospital while I contact HQ?
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
我去联系总部，你能问问镇上的人关于这家医院的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey, why don't you start with that girl over there?
Perhaps she'll tell you something.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
嘿，你不妨先问问那边那个女孩？
也许她会告诉你些什么。

scripts.translation:

总部确认了我的派遣任务就是这里。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
也许那个女孩不知道这个地方？
总部不会无缘无故派我来这里还撒谎。你能问问镇上其他人吗？

scripts.text:

I'll contact HQ again for more info.
Hey, why not ask that man over there?
I'm sure he'll know something.
scripts.translation:

他肯定知道些什么。

scripts.text:

An inn?
Good gracious!
If they'd have told me earlier I wouldn't have had to stand out here for so long!
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
旅馆？
天哪！
要是早点告诉我，我就不必在外面站这么久了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey... you know what...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
嘿...你知道吗...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I don't think I can move anymore because of my feet. Could you go to the inn for me?
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
我的脚好像动不了了。你能替我去一趟旅馆吗？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I can't carry my bags around so I'll stay here and watch over them while I treat my feet.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
我搬不动这些行李，所以我会留在这里看着它们，顺便处理一下我的脚。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I have to be back here again anyway.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉斯]
反正我最后还得回到这里。
谢谢你。

How'd it go?
scripts.translation:

怎么样了？

钥匙？
这下离我的目标又近了一步！
我们现在就开门吧！

????

门没锁？
怎么会这样？？？？？
？？？

Oh no!!!
Everything's falling apart.
Maybe we should wait for the doctor to come.....
scripts.translation:

糟糕！！！
一切都要崩塌了。
也许我们应该等医生来...

我躲在这里，因为我不应该出现在这里。

scripts.text:
[???]
My mom once told me.
The old lady's daughter was hospitalized here.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我妈妈曾告诉我。
那位老妇人的女儿曾在这里住院。

scripts.text:
[???]
She never got out of it though...
scripts.translation:
[???]
但她再也没有出来过...

scripts.text:
[???]
She wasn't the only one. There were many strange things going on at the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[???]
不止她一个人。医院里发生了很多奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[???]
That's why my mom doesn't want me coming around here.
scripts.translation:
[???]
所以我妈妈不让我来这里。

scripts.text:
[???]
No way Jose!
I got a spanking last time I was caught around here!
scripts.translation:
[???]
绝对不行！
上次我偷偷来这里被抓到，被狠狠打了一顿！

scripts.text:
[???]
If I'm caught again, it won't end with a spanking....
So scary.
scripts.translation:
[???]
如果再次被抓到，后果就不止是一顿打那么简单了....
好可怕。

scripts.text:
[???]
It's the lady who lives next door to us.
scripts.translation:
[???]
她是住在我们隔壁的那位女士。

scripts.text:
[???]
I saw her a few days ago doing something around the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[???]
几天前我看见她在医院附近做点什么。

scripts.text:
[???]
I couldn't see what she was doing from here, but I found some sticks there after she'd left.
scripts.translation:
[???]
从这里看不清她在做什么，但她走后我发现那里有一些树枝。

scripts.text:
[???]
I dunno.
Nothing's different except for the sticks.
scripts.translation:
[???]
不知道。
除了那些树枝，没什么变化。

scripts.text:
[???]
The old lady comes back once in a while to check on the sticks.
My heart races when that happens!
scripts.translation:
[???]
老妇人偶尔会回来看看那些树枝。
她一来我就心跳加速！

scripts.text:
[???]
Humph!!

[???]
Promise me you won't tell anyone that you saw me!!!
Promise?!
scripts.translation:
[???]
答应我，不要告诉任何人你看见我了！！！
答应我？！

scripts.text:
[???]
I couldn't see what she was doing from here, but I found some sticks there after she'd left.
scripts.translation:
[???]
从这里看不清她在做什么，但她走后我发现那里有一些树枝。

scripts.text:
[???]
Don't come any closer!
Old {0}!
How'd you know I was here?
scripts.translation:
[???]
别过来！
老{0}！
你怎么知道我在这里？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

There's a trace of a young child.
Think the child's gone home now.
scripts.translation:

当他们砍掉那棵老树来建医院时，我就知道会发生这种事。

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]

Far from curing people, they started to die.
So did my daughter...
scripts.translation:

节日将持续7天，请尽情享受吧。
