scripts.translation: 带回了遗失的财物

scripts.text:
[Isco]
There is a traditional festival held since ancient times
in Baryo Mahiwaga called the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
在Baryo Mahiwaga，自古以来就有一个传统节日，叫做'^7A96E0Pintados节日^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
I don't think I'll make it to the festival this time.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
我想这次我赶不上节日了。

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 为什么？

scripts.text:
[Isco]
I was going back to the village delivering 1000 Lesser Agimats, 1000 Silver Crosses, and 300 Dyestuffs as an errand from Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
我正准备回村，作为马来港的委托，运送1000个小型护身符、1000个银十字架和300份染料。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
But '^FF8440Bongisungisu^000000' appeared out of nowhere and took the items away from me.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
但'^FF8440Bongisungisu^000000'突然从不知哪里冒出来，抢走了我的物品。

scripts.text: Are you hurt?
scripts.translation: 你受伤了吗？

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Fortunately not.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
幸好没有。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
But I'm in deep trouble. The '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000' can't be held without those items. What should I do.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
但我陷入了大麻烦。没有那些物品，'^7A96E0Pintados节日^000000'就无法举办。我该怎么办。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Many adventurers are helping out but only collected...
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
许多冒险者在帮忙，但只收集到了...

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Lesser Agimat {0}, Silver Cross {1}, Dyestuff {2} so far.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
目前收集到了：小型护身符 {0}，银十字架 {1}，染料 {2}。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Sigh... We are still short of materials to start the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
唉...我们离举办'^7A96E0Pintados节日^000000'还差一些材料。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Oh~ Really? Wow!
Thanks! {0} {1}!!
He he. What did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
哦~真的吗？哇！
谢谢！{0} {1}！！
嘿嘿。你带了什么来？

scripts.text: Lesser Agimat (^FF0000{0}^000000)
Silver Cross (^FF0000{0}^000000)

[Isco]
Wow! {0} You've brought {1}!
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
哇！{0} 你带了 {1} 来！

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Wait. One... two...
Eh... oh? I already have all the {0} I need. {1}! But thank you for helping.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
等等。一...二...
呃...哦？我已经凑齐所需的 {0} 了。{1}！不过还是谢谢你的帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Wait. One... two...
I am {0} short of {1}. How many did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
等等。一...二...
我还差 {0} 个 {1}。你带了几个？

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Wait. One... two...
I am {0} short of Dyestuffs. What kind of Dyestuff did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
等等。一...二...
我还差 {0} 个染料。你带的是什么染料？

scripts.text: One?!
scripts.translation: 一个？！

scripts.text: Enter quantity.
scripts.translation: 输入数量

scripts.text:
[Isco]
He he... You've brought back one.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
嘿嘿...你带了一个回来。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
He he... I'm slow with numbers. I get lost when it's over 50. How many will you give me?
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
嘿嘿...我算数很慢。超过50我就晕了。你要给我多少？

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Sigh~ I'm lost! I can't count if the numbers are weird.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
唉~我晕了！数字太怪我就数不清。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Sigh~ {0}! Where is the {1}?

[Isco]
Sigh~ You don't have any {0}.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
唉~你没有 {0}。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
{0}! How many {1} can you give me from the {2} you have?
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
{0}！你拥有的 {2} 中，能给我多少 {1}？

scripts.text: Enter Quantity
scripts.translation: 输入数量

scripts.text: All
scripts.translation: 全部

scripts.text:
[Isco]
He he... I'm slow with numbers. I get lost when it's over 50. How many will you give me?
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
嘿嘿...我算数很慢。超过50我就晕了。你要给我多少？

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Sigh~ I told you I'm not good with numbers.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
唉~我说过我不擅长算数的。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Sigh... I'm short of {0}.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
唉...我还差 {0}。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
He he... Thanks. {0}!
Whoa! We've collected all the {1} we need. Happy~!
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
嘿嘿...谢谢。{0}！
哇！我们收集齐了所需的 {1}。开心~！

scripts.text:
[Isco]
He he... Thanks. {0}!
I only need {1} more {2}.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
嘿嘿...谢谢。{0}！
我还需要 {1} 个 {2}。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because you have too many items in your possession.
scripts.translation: 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Why do you want a Tattoo?
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
你为什么想要纹身？

scripts.text: What is a Tattoo?
scripts.translation: 什么是纹身？

scripts.text: I'm curious about the effect of Tattoos.
scripts.translation: 我很好奇纹身的作用。

scripts.text: I need a Tattoo.
scripts.translation: 我需要纹身。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
A Tattoo of a powerful monster is said to increase the ability of the holder.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
据说拥有强力魔物纹身的持有者，其能力会得到提升。

scripts.text: Awesome. How can I get one?
scripts.translation: 太棒了。我该怎么获得？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Drawing a Tattoo is a very holy task.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
绘制纹身是一项非常神圣的任务。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
10 Ancient Grudges to protect me while I draw Tattoos.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
10个古代的咒符，在我绘制纹身时保护我。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
1 Doll that looks like a powerful monster.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
1个看起来像强力魔物的玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
And last but not least, 1 Spirit Piece to imbue the energy of a powerful monster into the Tattoo.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
最后，也是最重要的，1个灵魂碎片，将强力魔物的能量注入纹身中。

scripts.text: What kind of Tattoo will you draw?
scripts.translation: 你会绘制哪种纹身？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I can draw 3 kinds of Tattoos.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
我可以绘制3种纹身。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Bangungot Agimat Tattoo for a powerful monster that comes from an old gigantic tree in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
般滚勾特守护纹身，对应来自马来港古老巨树中的强力魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo for a huge monster that can swallow the moon.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
食月者守护纹身，对应能吞下月亮的大型魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Buwaya Agimat Tattoo for a giant alligator that kidnaps people.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
宝箱巨鳄守护纹身，对应绑架人类的巨型鳄鱼人。

scripts.text: Where can I get the Spirit Pieces and Doll?
scripts.translation: 我在哪里可以获得灵魂碎片和玩偶？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
You can get these powerful items from Buwaya, Bangungot, and Bakonawa themselves but it won't be an easy task.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
你可以直接从宝箱巨鳄、般滚勾特和食月者身上获得这些强力物品，但这并不容易。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
This holy task isn't done every day. Tattoos are drawn only during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
这项神圣的任务并非每天都能进行。只有在“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”期间才能绘制纹身。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Which Tattoo's effect are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
你对哪种纹身的效果感到好奇？

scripts.text: Bangungot Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 般滚勾特守护纹身

scripts.text: Buwaya Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 宝箱巨鳄守护纹身

scripts.text: Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 食月者守护纹身

scripts.text: I have no questions.
scripts.translation: 我没有其他问题了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Bangungot's Spirit, and 1 Bangungot Doll to create
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
制作需要10个古代的咒符、1个般滚勾特灵魂碎片和1个般滚勾特玩偶

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The Bangungot Agimat Tattoo holds the energy of an old gigantic tree in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
般滚勾特守护纹身蕴含着马来港古老巨树中的能量。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Increases the effect of healing others by 4% and healing from others by 7%.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
提升对他人的治疗效果4%，并提升自身受到的治疗效果7%。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Buwaya's Spirit, and 1 Buwaya Doll to create
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
制作需要10个古代的咒符、1个宝箱巨鳄灵魂碎片和1个宝箱巨鳄玩偶

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The Buwaya Agimat Tattoo contains the energy from a giant alligator.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
宝箱巨鳄守护纹身蕴含着巨型鳄鱼人的能量。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Increases MATK by +7% and decreases Fixed Casting by 7%.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
提升魔法攻击(MATK)7%，并降低固定施法时间7%。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit, and 1 Bakonawa Doll to create
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
制作需要10个古代的咒符、1个食月者灵魂碎片和1个食月者玩偶

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo holds the energy from a gigantic monster that can swallow the moon.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
食月者守护纹身蕴含着能吞下月亮的巨型魔物的能量。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Increases ATK by +7% and ASPD by 10%.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
提升物理攻击(ATK)7%，并提升攻击速度(ASPD)10%。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Looks like you've got all the answers. Hope you enjoy your journey.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
看来你已经得到所有答案了。祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Do you have any questions about other Tattoo effects?
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
你还有其他关于纹身效果的问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The holy task of drawing Tattoos is only done during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'. Sorry but looks like the festival is not on.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
绘制纹身这项神圣的任务仅在“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”期间进行。抱歉，目前节日并未举行。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
You've come right on time during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
你来得正是时候，现在正值“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
There is no time like during the holy '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000' to draw Tattoos.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
绘制纹身，没有比神圣的“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”期间更好的时机了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The festival doesn't last long so I should start drawing. What Tattoo do you need?
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
节日时间不长，我该开始绘制了。
你需要什么纹身？

scripts.text: I will think it over.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text: Bangungot Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 般滚勾特守护纹身

scripts.text: Buwaya Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 宝箱巨鳄守护纹身

scripts.text: Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 食月者守护纹身

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Hope you enjoy the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
祝您在“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”玩得尽兴。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I think you are short on materials.
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of {0}'s Spirit, and 1 {1} Doll to create a ^EE1D11{2} Agimat Tattoo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
看来你的材料不足。
制作^EE1D11{2} Agimat 纹身^000000需要10个古代的咒符、1块{0}的精灵，以及1个{1}玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The materials are full with holy energy. I'm sure we'll get a great Tattoo using these.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
这些材料充满了神圣的能量。
我相信用这些材料一定能做出很棒的纹身。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Please don't interrupt while I'm working on drawing a holy Tattoo if you want it to come out right.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
如果你希望纹身绘制成功，请在我工作时不要打断我。

scripts.text: The Tattooist placed the Ancient Grudges around the workplace.
scripts.translation: 纹身师将古代的咒符摆放在工作台上。

scripts.text: The Ancient Grudge lit up and tools starts to glow. He smiled satisfyingly at the glowing tools and materials.
scripts.translation: 古代的咒符亮了起来，工具也开始发光。他满意地看着发光的工具和材料，露出了微笑。

scripts.text: And then {0} stared intensely at the doll as if to remember every detail of it in his head.
scripts.translation: 然后，{0} 盯着那个玩偶，仿佛要将其每一个细节都记在脑海中。

scripts.text: Aren't you going to start?
scripts.translation: 你还不开始吗？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Oh no, now you ruined it.
I cannot draw a Tattoo for someone like you who doesn't understand art. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
哎呀，这下全毁了。
我无法为像你这样不懂艺术的人绘制纹身。你可以拿回剩下的材料。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, {0} Doll, and Piece of {1}'s Spirit.
scripts.translation: 拿回了5个古代的咒符、1个{0}玩偶，以及1块{1}的精灵。

scripts.text: Think he will melt the doll with his eyes?
scripts.translation: 难道他想用眼神把玩偶融化吗？

scripts.text: He closed and opened his eyes slowly as if to memorize the doll in his head and then held up a glowing tool to start drawing.
scripts.translation: 他缓慢地闭上又睁开双眼，仿佛在脑海中铭记玩偶的模样，随后举起发光的工具开始绘制。

scripts.text: The {0} Tattoo was completed almost instantly.
scripts.translation: {0} 纹身几乎瞬间就完成了。

scripts.text: But he kept on looking at each corner of the drawing as if he didn't like some of its details.
scripts.translation: 但他仍盯着图案的每个角落，似乎对某些细节不太满意。

scripts.text: Looks good to me.
scripts.translation: 我觉得看起来不错

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
啧！我说过不要打断我！

scripts.text: The Tattooist ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 纹身师恼怒地撕碎了那张画。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I can't continue like this. Maybe another time. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
我没法这样继续下去了。也许改天再来吧。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, {0} Doll, and Piece of {1}'s Spirit.
scripts.translation: 拿回了5个古代的咒符、1个{0}玩偶，以及1块{1}的精灵。

scripts.text: He looked at the drawing intensely for a long time and then nodded with a satisfied smile.
scripts.translation: 他盯着那张画看了很久，最后满意地点了点头，露出了笑容。

scripts.text: Looks like he is satisfied with the {0} drawing.
scripts.translation: 看来他对{0}的图案很满意。

scripts.text: But now he is staring at the sky without doing anything else. What is he waiting for?
scripts.translation: 但现在他只是望着天空，什么也没做。他在等什么？

scripts.text: When will it be done?
scripts.translation: 什么时候能完成？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
啧！我说过不要打断我！

scripts.text: The Tattooist ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 纹身师恼怒地撕碎了那张画。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I can't continue like this. Maybe another time. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
我没法这样继续下去了。也许改天再来吧。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, {0} Doll, and Piece of {1}'s Spirit.
scripts.translation: 拿回了5个古代的咒符、1个{0}玩偶，以及1块{1}的精灵。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
.

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
. .
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
. .

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
. . .

[Tattooist]
. . . .

[Tattooist]
. . . . .

[Tattooist]
. . . . . .

[Tattooist]
. . . . . . .
The Tattooist's eyes started to shine after staring at the sky for awhile, then he broke the Piece of {0}'s Spirit with both his hands.
scripts.translation: 纹身师盯着天空看了一会儿，眼神开始发光，随后他用双手捏碎了{0}的精灵碎片。

scripts.text: The Piece of {0}'s Spirit is shattered into powder. The Tattooist's hands are glowing.
scripts.translation: {0}的精灵碎片碎成了粉末。纹身师的双手正散发着光芒。

scripts.text: Why did you break the pieces...
scripts.translation: 你为什么要捏碎那些碎片...

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
啧！我说过不要打断我！

scripts.text: The glowing light from his hands faded away. He starred at his hands for a while and then ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 他手上的光芒渐渐消退。他盯着自己的手看了一会儿，然后恼怒地撕碎了那张画。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I was this close to completing a wonderful piece but you ruined it. Not in a good mood. You can take the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
我本来马上就要完成一件杰作了，结果被你毁了。我现在心情很糟。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges and the doll.
scripts.translation: 收回了5个古代的咒符和那个玩偶。

scripts.text: He held up the powder in both hands and then blew it onto the drawing.
scripts.translation: 他双手捧着粉末，然后将其吹到了那张画上。

scripts.text: All Ancient Grudges started to burn and then the glowing light from the {0} drawing faded away.
scripts.translation: 所有的古代的咒符开始燃烧，随后{0}图案上的光芒也渐渐消失了。

scripts.text: Blinking light on top of the drawing.
scripts.translation: 画作上方闪烁着光芒。

scripts.text: Light faded away and the {0} drawing is no longer the simple one it was before.
scripts.translation: 光芒渐渐消退，{0}的图案不再像之前那样简单了。

scripts.text: The {0} drawing looks as if it is... alive.
scripts.translation: {0}的图案看起来仿佛...活了过来。

scripts.text: The Tattooist is finally satisfied and is all smiles.
scripts.translation: 纹身师终于满意了，脸上露出了笑容。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ha ha. It came out great.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
哈哈，效果很棒。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I'm sorry you had to wait for a long time. But it was worth it cause I haven't created a Tattoo of this quality in a long time.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
抱歉让您等了这么久。不过很值得，我已经很久没有做出过这种品质的纹身了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The ^EE1D11{0} Agimat Tattoo^000000 you've waited for is now completed.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
您等待已久的^EE1D11{0} Agimat纹身^000000已经完成了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Hope you enjoy the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
祝您在“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”玩得尽兴。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I came from afar and dropped everything to come and enjoy the 'Pintados Festival'.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我从远方赶来，放下了一切，只为来享受“Pintados Festival”。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I don't regret visiting but...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我不后悔这次旅行，但是...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I don't like the Tattoo I got after all I've gone through to get it.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
经历了这么多才得到的纹身，我其实并不喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've looked at it in the light but I think the Tattooist made a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我在光线下仔细看过，我觉得纹身师搞错了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
This ruined my whole visit.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
这毁了我整个行程。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Tsk!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
啧！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I heard of the 'Pintados Festival' and came all the way from Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我听说“Pintados Festival”，特意从昆仑赶来。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Just in case you might think otherwise, this is a mask on my face and not a tattoo.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
别误会，我脸上戴的是面具，不是纹身。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, hear me. This isn't the Tattoo I wanted.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
嘿，听我说。这不是我想要的纹身。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I asked for a Bakonawa Tattoo but the more I look at it, this is Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我要的是巴库暴龙纹身，但我越看越觉得，这是噩梦死神般滚勾特。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
No... you said that you wanted that one. Don't be so difficult.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
不...您明明说想要那个的。别这么难缠。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Don't you know that customer is king? Huh? Do you want a bad reputation?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
你不知道顾客就是上帝吗？哼？你想坏名声吗？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ugh... Can't believe this.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
唉...真是难以置信。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ah... I can't work with customers like this.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
唉...面对这样的顾客，我没法继续工作了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
How many times do I have to tell you, you said you wanted a Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
我都说了多少遍了，您明明说要纹噩梦死神般滚勾特的。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ouch, my throat... Shouting will get me nowhere.
scripts.translation:
[纹身师]
嘶...我的喉咙...大喊大叫解决不了任何问题。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
They say the Pintados Festival will only be held for one week.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
听说彩绘节只举办一周。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I came from Luoyang without knowing about the festival. Must be my lucky day.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我从洛阳来，之前并不知道有节日。看来是我的幸运之日。

scripts.text: ba-dum-DUM- ba-dum-DUM
scripts.translation: 咚-哒-咚- 咚-哒-咚-

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
The Pintados Festival wouldn't be a festival without a drummer.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
没有鼓手，彩绘节就不成其为节日了。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Why don't you join?
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
你要不要加入？

scripts.text: ba-dum-DUM- ba-dum-DUM
scripts.translation: 咚-哒-咚- 咚-哒-咚-

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
The Pintados from Pintados Festival means painted in our language.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
彩绘节里的“彩绘”在我们的语言里就是“被画”的意思。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
So that is probably why we have people drawing special Tattoos during the festival.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
所以大概是因为这个原因，节日期间大家会纹上特殊的纹身。

scripts.text: ba-dum-DUM- ba-dum-DUM
scripts.translation: 咚-哒-咚- 咚-哒-咚-

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
I don't remember it accurately, but they say the Pintados Festival was to celebrate a rich harvest.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年轻人]
我不太记得确切细节了，但据说彩绘节是为了庆祝丰收。

scripts.text: ba-dum-TSH- ba-dum-TSH-
scripts.translation: 咚-哒-嗒- 咚-哒-嗒-

scripts.text:
[Beat Catching Boy]
I always get energetic when I hear drums and sticks in a rhythmic beat.
scripts.translation:
[打拍子的男孩]
每当听到鼓棒敲击出有节奏的鼓点，我总是会充满活力。

scripts.text:
[Beat Catching Boy]
ba-dum-TSH- ba-dum-TSH- So much fun!
scripts.translation:
[打拍子的男孩]
咚-哒-嗒- 咚-哒-嗒- 太好玩了！

scripts.text: ba-dum-TSH- ba-dum-TSH-
scripts.translation: 咚-哒-嗒- 咚-哒-嗒-

scripts.text:
[Beat Catching Boy]
I may be using sticks to catch the beat right now but you never know if I'll grow big enough to play the drums, right?
scripts.translation:
[打拍子的男孩]
我现在虽然是用鼓棒打拍子，但说不定以后长大了就能打鼓了呢，对吧？
